notes.title: Nomad 1.9b Released, 10 Years Anniversary
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

It’s been a while! Nomad is now running on Unity 6, bringing a wave of improvements under the hood—better performance, smoother gameplay, and a solid foundation for the road ahead. It took a very long time converting the game to this new version, especially when everything else needed to be updated.

Alongside the engine upgrade, there's new content, automation features, balance tweaks, and a mountain of bug fixes. There’s a lot to unpack—read on for the full changelog!

Servers have been wiped due to this update.

[h1]Nomad is 10 years old[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/b82726105b6e1d90bcc6fcb82e1b75438689cf34.png[/img]
I just want to say thank you to everyone who has ever played the game. Whether you were here at the start or only stopped by for a while, it truly means a lot to me. Even if you’ve moved on, the fact that you spent time in Nomad is something I’ll always appreciate. Here's to 10 more years to 1.0 release! :D

[h1]Water Barrels Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/6a58e6c92c7b9238b1fd326143cb1880751914dd.png[/img]
Water Barrels will now automatically fill up nearby Hydroponics Stations when the station runs out of Water Bottles and there are still seeds inside left. Water Barrel must have Water Bottles inside it for this to work.

[h1]Fuel Table Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/d517138f761d89a591912687b9a9f170f2ddb9ba.png[/img]
Fuel Tables will automatically fill up nearby Generators with Fuel when the generator runs out. Fuel Table must have Fuel inside for this to work.

[h1]New Item, Blood Moon Amulet[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/5d74b3746081fd5e4de235eab48b16e24abafc2b.png[/img]
Blood Moon Amulets are now in the game and when used will spawn a Blood Moon on the next sunset. Blood Moon Amulets can be found in Blood Moon Graves or trading Lost Souls to The Reaper during a Blood Moon.

[h1]New Furnace, Blast Furnace[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/f95567d43fdb5cde1d88d3b905dfdfdb764f8a96.png[/img]
A new furnace has been added, the Blast Furnace. This furnace is a bigger and better furnace and has 40 slots to smelt all your nomad things.

[h1]Automation With Machines[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/8f489a93a6c1fafb6855963e98b96445650d2534.png[/img]
Managing your machines just got a whole lot easier. With the new update, you can now automate item transfers from machines directly into storage chests!

This feature currently works with the Auger Drill and Oil Pump, with support for more machines on the way. To get started, install the new Hopper Mod into an Auger Drill or Oil Pump. This allows the machine to begin sending its items out automatically.

But where do the items go? That’s where the Magnet Mods come in. Place an Auger Drill Magnet or Oil Pump Magnet inside any storage chest, and the connected machine will send its items straight there—no manual hauling needed.

Set it up once and enjoy a cleaner, more efficient operation while you focus on what matters most— raiding!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]New Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Blood Moon Amulet - Use this item to summon a Blood Moon
[*] Red Present - Nomad's 10th Birthday Item. Open it to get gifts!
[*] Blast Furnace - A 40 slot "better" furnace
[*] Hopper Mod - To allow the machine to transfer items OUT
[*] Auger Drill Magnet - Place within a storage chest to get items from the drill IN
[*] Oil Pump Magnet - Place within a storage chest to get items from the pump IN
[/list]
[h2]Engine[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated to Unity 6, should see performance increases
[*] Updated to latest Facepunch Steamworks
[*] Updated to latest version of TNet
[*] Updated Anti Cheat system
[*] Better handling of saving player inventories
[*] Better Ping handling on servers
[*] Better server connection
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Official Servers added to Official List
[*] Fixed a bug with Deer and Zombie when moving too soon on a Nav Mesh
[*] Fixed issue with Deer and Zombie not adhering to Nav Meshes
[*] Added lobby server IP fallback if the server cannot read from the lobby.txt file
[*] Fixed getting stuck on 'Loading Pylons' when loading into a server
[*] Fixed an issue with player inventories saving too regularly
[*] Fixed an issue surrounding reloading weapons too fast
[*] Fixed an issue with using items (food/drink/medical) and multiplying its effect
[*] Fixed an issue with the Time of Day sometimes not firing Blood Moon events (stop or start)
[*] Fixed an issue with player inventories deleting when loading into a server
[*] Fixed an issue when player sleeper is killed and player spawning in as naked with no new inventory
[*] Fixed a sound bug with fireworks at the safe zone
[/list]
[h2]Balance & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Auger Drill drop chances improved
[*] Steam client will now auto retry when it fails to authenticate
[*] Deer, Stag and Doe default spawn rates significantly increased (change in config file for server owners)
[*] Server default max ping increased to 1000, up from 600 (change in config file for server owners)
[*] Increased default loot spawns, barrel spawns, and mining nodes spawns (change in config file for server owners)
[*] Hitting a tree with the incorrect tool to gather will now prompt the player about their error
[*] Reduced Saleh's gold cost to gamble down to 2 Gold Bars, from 3 Gold Bars
[*] Fuel now requires 2 Oil Bottles, down from 3 bottles
[*] Oil Pump will now gather oil every 5 ticks, down from every 6 ticks
[*] Crafting with Water Bottles (for food items) will now give you back Empty Bottle
[*] Fuel Tables will automatically fill up Generators when the Generator runs out of Fuel. Fuel Table must have Fuel inside them for this to work 
[*] Water Barrels will automatically fill up Hydroponics Stations when the station runs out of Water and there are seeds still inside. Water Barrels must have Water Bottles in them
[*] New icons for most items
[*] Updated loading tips
[*] Updated some tutorial quests and text
[*] Death Scythe now shoots faster
[*] Iron Mask now provides 10 armour
[*] Reaper's Mask now provides 12 armour
[*] Black Boots now provide 6 armour
[*] Bag With Umbrella now provides 8 armour
[*] Stop Sign now provides 6 armour
[*] Riot Shield now provides 8 armour
[*] Clothing items will now better show their armour value
[*] Nights are now darker
[*] Added TAA, FAA, and DLSS
[*] Reduced Furnace to 24 slots, down from 32
[*] Reduced Auto Hammer to 24 slots, down from 40
[*] New event props been added to Safe Zone when an event is active (christmas, halloween etc)
[*] The server will now automatically enable special events according to the month
[*] Death Scythe no longer scraps to metal
[*] You can now use items in the inventory whilst auto running
[*] Auger Drill audio range decreased
[*] A special 10th anniversary of Nomad Theme has been created for the main menu
[/list]

notes.title: Nomad 1.8b Released
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

Not quite the big update you probably hoped for. This is because I've been working on Nyran Survivors. However, an update is still an update!

I have removed the southern safe zone because it was splitting up players. I want the safe zone to be a busy hub for players. However one problem with having one safe zone was people spawn camping just outside the "safe area", killing people who walked outside. That's why two safe zones were made. But now, there is a new NPC called a Camper Driver that will teleport you to a bunch of different locations straight from the Safe Zone. No more death from safe zone campers.

Servers have not been wiped.

[h1]Camper Driver[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/5b9253179d5b64b2127edac60595e7073b4409b8.png[/img]
The Camper Driver will teleport you to locations around the map. Some locations are locked behind items. For example, if you have a Pinewood Charm item in your inventory, you can teleport to Pinewood City. These items can be found throughout the world.

[h1]Machine Balance[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/45d4f8bbec6a9639c796777c64914bbd2bc8df9b.png[/img]
Machines have been rebalanced and Fuel also now costs 3 Oil Bottles.

[h1]Hydroponics Station[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/e5e0b502a3f60ad2690e8af5bac5e28ec3ebdf65.png[/img]
Hydroponics Station will now grant the farming achievement.

[h1]Winter Is Here[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/bb518c014c299dfa17e4436bec575d52e9521258.png[/img]
The Nomad Christmas tree and Safe Zone fireworks have been enabled. All players will start a special present and depending if you are premium or not, a full Elf or Santa suit. Happy Holidays!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Motel Key, used to teleport to the Motel
[*] Bottle Of Beer, used to teleport to the Trailer Park
[*] Pinewood Charm, used to teleport to Pinewood City
[*] Tape Measure, used to teleport to the Industrial area
[/list]
[h2]Engine[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated to Unity 2023.1.20f1, should see performance increases
[*] Significantly increased loading times when loading into a server 
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some nav mesh problems
[*] Fixed a security issue
[/list]
[h2]Balance & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated official IP server list
[*] Fuel now requires 3 Oil Bottles to craft
[*]  Oil Pump now gathers Oil Bottles every 6th smelting tick (30 minutes)
[*]  Water Pump now gathers Water every 3rd smelting tick (15 minutes)
[*]  Empty Bottle tooltip adjusted
[*]  All seeds tooltips adjusted
[*]  Picking up containers, furnaces, machines and campfires no longer requires authorization in the area
[*]  Skipping a quest timer reduced to 5 minutes, down from 10 minutes
[*]  Quest start timer reduced to 5 minutes, down from 10 minutes
[*]  Hydroponics Stations will now grant the farming achievement

notes.title: Nomad 1.7b Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

1.7 has so far been a success however it did launch with a [i]few[/i] issues. Hotfixes have been rolling out, trying to squish as many bugs as we go. 

Some things had to change as it was causing too much server lag. Hydroponics Stations no longer need a nearby Water Barrel for a water supply. Instead now you directly put Water Bottles inside of the station.

Fuel Tables will no longer automatically fill up nearby Generators. The crafting materials have been reduced to reflect the change. This was simply causing too much lag on populated servers.

Nomad Celebration holiday has ended. Thanks to everyone who showed up and watched the fireworks.

Below is the complete merged changelog from 1.7.0b upwards.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Engine[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated to Unity 2023.1.8f1 version, should see increased performance
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with campfires not cooking food properly
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Dirty Water to burn to Burnt Food
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the server to crash when players get rubber banded/warped back to the servers position
[*] Fixed a bug that made Blood Moons not work on sunset
[*] Fixed a terrain glitch near Pinewood
[*] Fixed a bug that caused fireworks not to produce any sound
[*] Fixed a bug that caused placeables to delete when placed on a hatch
[*] Fixed a bug that made lights from the Flamer appear on the world map
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some items not to scrap into their proper items
[*] Fixed a bug that caused powered lights to enable when the player is not in distance
[*] Fixed a bug that caused mining nodes trying to search infinitely for an empty place to spawn in the world. It will now only search twice in the world for an empty place to spawn
[*] Fixed a bug in player and vehicle network lerp functions that didn't properly take into account the frame timings
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Hydroponics Station light to bypass the light culling system
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the server to crash sometimes when filling up Dew Catchers when it rains
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Blood Moon Chests not to delete when destroyed
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Water Barrels not to delete when destroyed
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Hydroponics Station not to delete when destroyed
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Fuel Station not to delete when destroyed
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Generators not to delete when destroyed
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Auto Hammers not to delete when destroyed
[/list]
[h2]Balance & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pickup sound effects added when looting Doggos and Plants in the world
[*] Wall torches intensity increased
[*] Wall torches max light range increased
[*] Campfires light intensity reduced
[*] Furnace light intensity reduced
[*] Increased the amount of chat messages showed before it gets removed from chat to 24, up from 12
[*] Added more words to the profanity filter, naughty naughty!
[*] Added more death item spawn points to the player 
[*] Increased the sound range of vehicles to 250 meters on all low, med and high RPM sounds
[*] Adjusted vehicle handling
[*] Pinewood Bus now culls out when at distance
[*] Ceiling and Hatch support range has doubled. It no longer requires a wall on the foundation for support, but will now check the next foundation's wall across from it for support
[*] Optimized the check for Hydroponics Stations when removing or adding water to Water Barrels
[*] Optimized the check for powered generators within the area
[*] Reduced the amount of particles the Auger Drill produces
[*] Included the ability to peek inside Water Barrel, Generators, Fuel Tables and Hydroponics Stations to the admin camera
[*] Arrows and Bolts no longer stick to the hit surface but instead spawns the ammo back at hit position
[*] Optimized how machines and furnaces work on smelting ticks
[*] Hydroponics Station no longer requires a Water Barrel for water supply, instead you put water bottles directly inside of the station
[*] Water Barrels tooltip and Hydroponics Station tooltip changed to reflect this change
[*] Increased the storage size of Hydroponics Station
[*] Fuel Tables no longer automatically refill Generators
[*] Fuel Table tooltip changed to reflect this change
[*] Fuel Table now costs 2x Wood and 2x Metal to craft
[*] Water Barrel now costs 2x Metal and 1x Copper
[*] Furnace smoke reduced
[*] Auto Hammers no longer work on Cardboard (tier 1) or Wooden (tier 2) base structures and the tooltip has been changed to reflect this change
[*] Lowered the time it takes to receive an item from The Reaper and Saleh
[*] You can no longer bypass the wait time of receiving an item through The Reaper or Saleh
[*] You now have to wait 10 minutes when joining a server to start a quest
[*] Nomad Celebration event ended
[*] Auto Hammer now has a 10m cooldown on each base structure it repairs
[/list]

notes.title: Nomad 1.7b Released
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

1.7 has arrived bringing new changes and performance updates. It's pretty big, read it below.

[h1]Nomad Is Turning 8 Years Old[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/be2dd8672564241a507c7ff4eb489b0e01bd7518.png[/img]
Nomad is 8 years old, thank you for your continued support over the years, it means a lot!

New fireworks have been added around the safe zones which will only be enabled at night. Be sure to be around for the show!
 
[h1]Auger Drill Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/45d4f8bbec6a9639c796777c64914bbd2bc8df9b.png[/img]
The Auger Drill is now powered by generators. If you power a Generator with Fuel near an Auger Drill, it will activate it. The smelting time of the Auger Drill has also been increased, it will now smelt every 3rd smelting tick on the server by default.

[h1]Blood Moon Graves Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/34f89fb1fc0959e537400bced15c83f0a8c892e5.png[/img]
Blood Moon Graves now have a high chance of zombies spawning when looting. More Blood Moon Graves will now spawn around the map during a Blood Moon too.

[h1]Campfire Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/d04dac7d6f4ba808f9d0c30e2ada00126e30925a.png[/img]
Campfires will now cook food one tick at a time instead of cooking the entire container in one tick. This is more inline with how furnaces work so it's more consistent.

In addition to the food per tick changes, campfires will also now have a high chance of burning meat when cooked. The smoke effect has been changed too.

[h1]Dew Catcher Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/fe0ba216ab82bb59779b9a01a95e47f4813491a5.png[/img]
The Dew Catcher has been reworked to act more like how the other containers work. Simply fill the Dew Catcher with Empty Bottles and it will automatically fill up with Dirty Water if it's placed outside. It can hold up to 4 Empty Bottles (or Canteens) at a time, and will fill up every 6th smelting tick, regardless if it rains or not. However if it does rain, the Dew Catcher will fill up the bottles.

[h1]Oven[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/8dd05a564a43ef5ec72ae84a5d9f0784fbaa361b.png[/img]
To combat the new addition of food burning in campfires, we have introduced an electric oven. The oven requires a generator nearby to power it and requires 4 metal and 2 copper to craft. It can hold up to 24 uncooked items and does not burn food at all.

[h1]Fuel Table[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/d517138f761d89a591912687b9a9f170f2ddb9ba.png[/img]
Fill the Fuel Table up with Fuel and it will automatically fill up nearby Generators with Fuel when they are running low. This will keep your bases running for longer periods of time. It requires 2x Wood, 2x Fuel and 4x Metal to craft. It has 40 slots but only Fuel can be placed inside.

[h1]Auto Hammer[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/401e09423a1a53219e7cbb4b33f89479ea5ea0f7.png[/img]
Automatically repair all base foundations, walls, ceilings, doors, garage doors and doorways. The Auto Hammer works like a storage chest but only construction items can be placed within it. Wood, Metal, Improved Metal and Stone. Once construction items are placed inside, it will automatically repair all structures if the health falls below 70%. It does not need to be powered by a generator and costs 4 Metal, 4 Improved Metal and 4 Copper to craft.

The Auto Hammer requires 3 of the material to repair the base structure. Making it more expensive than manually doing it, but allows for some offline protection. The Auto Hammer will not repair a structure if the damage exceeds the health of the structure.

The range of the Auto Hammer is same as the generator when powering machines and lights. So if you have a large base, multiple Auto Hammers may need to be placed down, jotted around the base for full protection.

[h1]Hydroponics Station[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/e5e0b502a3f60ad2690e8af5bac5e28ec3ebdf65.png[/img]
The Hydroponics Station is a place where you can grow plants in-doors without the fear of others looting your crops. The Hydroponics Station requires a powered Generator and a Water Barrel nearby in order to work. Simply put up to 6 seeds inside of the station and they will grow automatically. The station will only consume water if or when the seed grows. Make sure your nearby Water Barrel is stocked up with water, as the station needs that to work.

The station will grow your seeds every 4th smelting tick, roughly around 20 minutes.

[h1]Water Barrel[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/6a58e6c92c7b9238b1fd326143cb1880751914dd.png[/img]
As mentioned above, the Water Barrel is required to make the Hydroponics Station operate however, it can also be used as a place to store all your water within your base. It has 40 slots but only Water Bottles can be placed inside.

[h1]Water Pump[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/1187760924b83af72c5be28108aeedba9ea72f93.png[/img]
The Water Pump is a great way to passively fill up empty bottles or canteens without needing to purify them at a campfire. The Water Pump requires a nearby powered generator to work and only Empty Bottles or Half/Empty Canteens can be placed inside.

[h1]Oil Pump[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/8f489a93a6c1fafb6855963e98b96445650d2534.png[/img]
The Oil Pump will automatically pump oil from out of the ground every 3rd smelting tick. It's a great way to passively get oil to convert into fuel to power your bases. The Oil Pump requires 4x Wood, 4x Improved Metal, 1x Generator Engine and 4x copper to craft and can hold only Oil Bottles inside.

It requires a powered generator nearby in order to operate.

[h1]Base Hatch[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/54129dc8bcaed57a3ec0595a540cb82d661ec112.png[/img]
Now you can build your own hatches and climb your way to the next level of your base. The ladder is included, you can stack multiple hatches on top of each other to make one giant ladder leading to the top of your base!

Hatches follow the same tiers as the rest of the base structures. Cardboard > Wood > Stone > Metal > Improved Metal and has the same crafting costs as ceilings/floors.

Hatches also follow the same support system as the ceiling, meaning that a wall much be present under or around the hatch for support. Without a supporting wall, the hatch will destroy itself.

[h1]Mods[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/7d816e1d6778367aba2819e73ba4954d3c1efb11.png[/img]
There's a new section in the crafting menu, under Tools called "Mods". These mods when placed in their respective places will enable special passives. For example, adding the Fuel Tank mod to a generator will decrease the consumption rate of Fuel by 10%, or the Oven Grill mod which increases storage capacity. 

These mods are locked behind recipes, which can be found in barrels and loot pallets scattered around the world.

More mods will be coming in later patches when more machines come.

[h1]Weather & Sky Updates[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/3026dc36dc6cc37605fe9f0ff16431d2006fb078.png[/img]
The weather system has been improved to provide more variation of clouds, better quality stars at night and better lighting. Stars are also bigger and now rotate around the skybox during the night. Sun and moon now has smoother movement when progressing through the day.

There is a 20% chance of rain per weather tick, 20% of which will be a storm. This should calm the storms so you don't see so many in a play session.

[h1]Zombies Rebalanced[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/a3473df02751a66bc8afd321fa33fa3b04cb1290.png[/img]
Zombies attack speed has been greatly reduced and their damaged adjusted.

[h1]World Music Changed[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/ef1e7b19586ed08836900609f9888490e1ed5adb.png[/img]
All world music in the game has been changed. Nice!

[h1]New Steam Achievements Added[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/e00239d5678a9df8ed6e9b947a34212f6e8f49e7.png[/img]
New Steam achievements have been added for you to obtain. Time to farm your 100% completion progress again.

[h1]Nomad Premium[/h1]
Level up your Nomad experience by buying Premium. Buy it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/431430/Nomad__Premium/

[h1]Skin Variety Pack[/h1]
Choose from 12 extra skins to play with. Buy it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/508800/

There is so much more added to this version, read the complete changelog below for more information.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Engine[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated to the latest Unity 2023 version, should see increased performance
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with storage cupboards always spawning on 80%
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the mouse not to set back to in-game when opening a door with the interact menu open
[*] Fixed a bug where multiple generators placed together would turn off lights and machines if one generator is running and the others are not
[*] Fixed an issue with the crafting menu not scrolling properly
[*] Fixed an issue that caused base structures to leave a gap in-between two walls sometimes
[*] Fixed a bug that made players receive chat messages too early when loading into a server
[*] Fixed texture on Cardboard, Metal and Improved Metal Low Walls
[*] Fixed a bug that incorrectly showed the next blood moon during a blood moon when doing the command /bloodmoon
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a new day to start at sun rise, rather than midnight
[*] Fixed a bug that caused sleepers not to drop their ammo
[/list]
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gem Stone Stack added
[*] Diamond Stack added
[*] Burnt Food item added
[*] Oven added. costs 4 metal and 2 copper to create and can cook food without burning
[*] Fuel Table added, will automatically refill nearby generators with fuel if the generator is running low. can only place fuel inside
[*] Auto Hammer added. Automatically repair base structures below 70% health
[*] Fuel Tank Mod added

notes.title: Nomad 1.6.1b Released
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

Looks like people overall are enjoying the Blood Moon update, but I got some feedback regarding the balance of zombies when the Blood Moon is active. 

Blood Moons were originally designed to be end game content for people who are Level 10, full talents and full Legendary weapons and armour as well damage increase accessories. You are supposed to die and slowly progress getting Lost Souls so it makes your next Blood Moon more manageable.

But it seems many people are missing that point and are wanting to participate in Blood Moons with little or no gear. This is overall fine, there's no point adding fun events into the game if people can't play them without spending a bunch of time first. 

This patch will aim to nerf the Blood Moon so it's more manageable but still needing gear to properly survive. The spawns of the zombies have been drastically reduced but keeping the same buffed health and movement speed.

I have also noticed quite a bit of lag when zombies are spawning within Blood Moons. This is because many people are using cars and the zombies are just spawning behind and not aggro'ing anything. Leaving the server with over 200 inactive zombies spread throughout the world. This patch aims to fix this by deleting all none aggro'd zombies every time new zombies spawn. Keeping the zombie count low but not interfering with them if they are aggro'd onto a player. This should also help a lot when surviving a Blood Moon.

Read below for the full changelog. It's nothing major, just a simple balance update for Blood Moons.

notes.title: Nomad 1.6.0b Released
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

This is a big patch, probably the biggest patch Nomad has received in its years of development. It fixes a lot of core problems with the game and adds a bunch of new content.

You can read below for the full patch notes on what changed.

[h1]Blood Moons[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/5d74b3746081fd5e4de235eab48b16e24abafc2b.png[/img]
Blood Moons will happen every 8 days in game (every 8 hours). When a Blood Moon starts, it will spawn zombies at an increased rate, zombies will have 50% more health and they move at an increased rate.

Blood Moons are deadly, stay inside a protected area (your base or safe zone) or you could venture outside and find something new. 

[h1]Blood Moon Graves[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/34f89fb1fc0959e537400bced15c83f0a8c892e5.png[/img]
To those who seek a thrill, during a Blood Moon graves will spawn around the world. They act like Pallets, so walking up to them and looting them will harvest Lost Souls. They might be someone who is interested in these souls...

[h1]The Reaper of Death[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/2b7093998040e7cba69b5e156c73c40af687d4ba.png[/img]
Meet The Reaper. He will only spawn at a Blood Moon. Trade him Lost Souls to obtain special Blood Moon exclusive items. You can find him at both Safe Zones.

Talk to him when a Blood Moon is active to get a free Death Scythe weapon. The Death Scythe is only usable within a Blood Moon unless you wearing the full Reaper's Set.

[h1]Blood Moon Items[/h1]
When a Blood Moon is active, there are exclusive items that can be obtained.

[b]NEVER-ENDING TOILET PAPER[/b]
Negates bleed effects.

[b]BRIMSTONE BAND[/b]
Increase the chance of mining Sulphur.

[b]METAL BAND[/b]
Increase the chance of mining Improved Metal.

[b]DIVINE PENDANT[/b]
Reduces Zombie damage by 50%

[b]BLACK PENDANT[/b]
Increases damage to Zombies by 25%

[b]BLOOD PENDANT[/b]
Bleeding now heals you.

[b]BLOOD STORAGE CHEST[/b]
A very large storage chest with 40 slots.

[b]REAPER'S MASK [/b]
Provides 10 armour. When wearing the full REAPER'S SET players can use the Death Scythe outside of Blood Moons

[b]REAPER'S ARMOUR[/b]
Provides 10 armour. When wearing the full REAPER'S SET  players can use the Death Scythe outside of Blood Moons

[b]REAPER'S BOTTOMS[/b]
Provides 7 armour. Highest armour value for leg items. When wearing the full REAPER'S SET players can use the Death Scythe outside of Blood Moons

[b]REAPER'S BOOTS[/b]
Provides 7 armour. Highest armour value for boots. When wearing the full REAPER'S SET players can use the Death Scythe outside of Blood Moons

[b]DEATH SCYTHE[/b]
A new weapon. Claim for free at The Reaper. The Reaper can be found at both Safe Zones when a Blood Moon is active.

More items have been added, these are just related to The Blood Moon. See the full changelog below for a more detailed view of what's new.

[h1]Generators[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/71b485cd8a27928ef7562c15e56514944925c71c.png[/img]
Generators can now be placed to generate power to your base. Lights have been added to Metal and Improved Metal ceilings and once a generator is placed near them (and it's on!) the lights will become active.

Generators require Fuel for them to function and will power anything within a 35m radius.

[h1]Improved Interactions[/h1]
The player who placed a base structure down will now appear in the tooltip when looking at it. This is to help group play to determine who placed that wall so that person can upgrade it. 

You can now also pick up empty Campfires, Furnaces, Auger Drills, Generators and all types of Storage Chests. Simply press F to pick them up, but they have to be completely empty with no items inside.

[h1]Improved Animations[/h1]
Player and character animations will now smooth blend between each other. Idle animations will only move the characters head, rather than the head and arms. No more Naruto run.

NPC's will now head track the player when close.

There are loads more that can't possibly fit in this post, read below for the changelog containing all of the stuff added, bug fixes, changes and tweaks.

[h1]Nomad Premium[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/b82726105b6e1d90bcc6fcb82e1b75438689cf34.png[/img]
Nomad Premium is the ultimate DLC to have, containing but not limited to; 26 Exclusive player skins, Premium gold coloured name tags, Access to /kits, 20+ Death effects when your character dies, Spray your Steam avatar on anything in game and many, many more benefits and features.

Hello Survivors!

Quite a big patch. New Pinewood, new ammo system, new achievements and lots more!

[h1]New Pinewood[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/c59d22c3e6cb126dd860fb6e338a2535e30da82b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/509191acf280d8cda30dca1a90620bad1d22372c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/8de033c9b640021485a6b68a681a1d12d4e47677.png[/img]

Pinewood needed some love. It was boring and looked awful. I took the time to remake it and now it features a full city. 

[h1]New Ammo System[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/70babb7c0764db1953d3e7c41b348d416333bc42.png[/img]
There are now 5 types of ammo for you to pick up around the world. 

- Pistol Ammo
- SMG Ammo
- AR Ammo
- Shotgun Ammo
- Sniper Ammo

This should also simplify all weapon types and their ammo types. No longer need 2 AR Rifles with 2 different ammo types. 

All recipes have also been updated to reflect the new change. Simply craft the ammo you want and it will store in the "ammo inventory"

You will lose all ammo on death. Dropped next to your body per stack.

Picking up ammo will automatically fill your ammo count in the respective category.

To drop or store the ammo, simply click the icon on the side inside of inventory.

[h1]Death Box Removed[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/09de11805e60ae81195f8b2eb5782f731a999b3c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/e6e6e09af514a8cf506f7b248d562969eb8a419e.png[/img]

Overall XP gains have been increased throughout the game as well as Pallets now giving XP and cash.

notes.title: Nomad 1.2.1b Released
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

Couple of bug fixes for the last update. Some things were a bit broken and missing tooltips. Also noticed a lot of people don't know where to start when they begin in Nomad. Nomad offers lots of content and stuff to do but people just don't know where to start.

This update helps change this by adding in a Tutorial system that new players (and veterans) can follow! The system will tell you exactly what to do on the right hand side of the screen and will reward you by completing each step. 

The tutorial system will take you through equipping your first item to creating your very own base and gambling with Saleh. It's not a complete tutorial of the game, but it's a start. Over the next few patches I will be extending the tutorial system.

You can skip the tutorial system by doing /tskip or hide and show the tutorial by doing /thide or /tshow

For the full list of changes, see the changelog below.

Thanks for playing,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/45d4f8bbec6a9639c796777c64914bbd2bc8df9b.png[/img]

The Auger Drill is an automatic machine that drills through your foundations and gathers all mining materials. Simply power it with Fuel and let it run. It does not damage your foundations and can be only placed on foundations. 

Caution, it is loud!

Gold Ore is exclusive to only the Auger Drill and won't find it through Mining Nodes. Expect to see more exclusive items through the drill in the coming patches. 

[h1]Copper[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/445e925a9d8851006cfb497f5b31cebdc9b270ce.png[/img]

Also in this update is Gold Ore, which can be only found through the Auger Drill.

Gold Ore is exclusive to only the Auger Drill and won't find it through Mining Nodes. Expect to see more exclusive items through the drill in the coming patches.

notes.title: Nomad 1.0.2.1b Released
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

More rolling updates for 1.0. This patch I focused on balance changes and adding new content within the game. We're stable enough to do that, but I am taking my time adding new content as I want ensure everything goes smoothly and we're bug free.

In addition to this, I'm also focusing on sorting out gameplay features and items. Stuff like Sickness, which was pretty pointless and there was no way of curing it.

Below is everything that got added in this patch. Enjoy!

[h1]Nomad Premium[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/b82726105b6e1d90bcc6fcb82e1b75438689cf34.png[/img]
Nomad Premium is the ultimate DLC to have, containing but not limited to; 26 Exclusive player skins, Premium gold coloured name tags, Access to /kits, 20+ Death effects when your character dies, Spray your Steam avatar on anything in game and many, many more benefits and features.

Level up your Nomad experience by buying Premium. Buy it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/431430/Nomad__Premium/

[h1]Skin Variety Pack[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/7e88c9dcb6e7793251345c9eb24b3b22dbfcac5a.png[/img]
The Variety Skin Pack is available. This DLC contains 11 new skins for you to flex with inside of the game. Simply change your skin in the customize tab in the main menu.

Buy it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/508800/


[h1]Reduced Networking Footprint[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/83aec57e9045a28f4f5a47462e22ade783d4feb4.png[/img]
I have spent a lot of time revisiting the networking side of Nomad by reducing the total number of bytes being sent over the network by ~90%. Even though I visted this back in 0.9.99.3, the total bytes was still almost 300 per packet in some cases. Not good! With this new change, we are achieving 24 bytes per packet. 

This means no more server bottle necks, potential for massive player and zombie counts and increased server performance. Great stuff! 

Due to this, the server tick rate has been massively increased to ensure everything is smooth and hit-reg is improved. Butter.

[h1]Plant Fibers[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/0e009e3bbfb9355fac8a8acb7263a6ea8322f310.png[/img]
Plants have been added throughout the world. Harvest these plants to gather the new resource, Plant Fibers. Plant Fibers can be used to create Cloth, a much needed resource. 

Later on, this resource will have more uses.

[h1]Iron Helmet & Riot Shield Nerfs[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/c812510bb6d6d7d6f0ee1dee6dfc6fee006930d1.png[/img]
The Iron Helmet and Riot Shield are way too overpowered. They block 100% of the bullets from the back of the player, and from the front of the head of the player.

In this patch and future patches the Iron Helmet will negate 1 bullet and Riot Shield will negate the first 2 bullets from [b]each[/b] player, then both will have a cooling off period for 5 minutes.

I want these items to be strong, they are designed to be super offensive and used when raiding or when attacking. However the current way it was balanced, it was too strong. By negating only the first few bullets from each player, it stays strong but also stays in line because each player must hit your item before they can deal damage to you.

[h1]Sickness[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/1021e8fd5a7487324e3491c82c7fdcae3cb16465.png[/img]
Sickness didn't really do anything and was pretty useless. This patch has buffed sickness quite a bit and also introduced a new item to cure it, Charcoal Tablets. Sickness now reduces armor by 50% and increases the drain on your food and water values by 5x. It's harsh, don't get sick.

Charcoal Tablets require 2 Charcoal and can be crafted in the player craft menu, under Medical.

Sickness now applies randomly when you are wet. The longer you are outside in the rain, the more chance of getting sick. Other ways of getting sick is by eating dodgy food or drinking dirty water. Don't do any of those things.

[h1]Door Security & UI Update [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/7c0f500c31bcd1a3198f65ee58319164e36df681.png[/img]
Doors no longer use only digits for the keycodes. From this patch onwards, door keycodes are now alphanumeric, meaning you can use A-Z 0-9 and some special characters * & + etc. Keycodes are still 1-4 characters long. 

This will make guessing door keycodes a lot harder.

[h1]Storm Scope Updated[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/ef1e7b19586ed08836900609f9888490e1ed5adb.png[/img]
Storm iron sights were pretty bad, so I've updated them. Storm and the Legendary Storm both have holo sights attached. The aim of this change is to make the Storm one of the strongest weapons in the game, as it should be but players wasn't really using it as the iron sights were pretty poor.

[h2]Shipwreck Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/dba8c82ec53f783f2d9deef03de08208adb0825a.png[/img]
The map has been updated around the shipwreck. It is now a lootable area with shipping containers. Find all sorts of items here.

[h2]Cafe Area Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/16165ce163ad41798bd3633bd635f014a115e828.png[/img]
The cafe area is now a motel! Expect more loot from this area.

[h2]Airfield Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/b80f06a32b937d7de65eac47997af090b917c1c6.png[/img]
Just a small update to the airfield. The airfield now have fences around the important parts. Nothing new but makes escaping from here a little harder so expect to fight others!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed notification for "Incorrect tool to gather" popping up globally
[*] You can now fill half canteens
[*] Fixed a bug that made players move when inside of new keycode door UI
[*] Fixed a bug that didn't show the antidote item being used when using the item
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player to use medical items twice in some cases
[*] Fixed a bug that caused lod quality not to change when selecting ultra preset in settings
[*] Fixed a bug that caused hunger, thirst and regen to stop working after getting inside of a vehicle
[*] Fixed a bug that caused player death box to spawn outside of the world when player died
[*] Fixed a bug that caused player currency didn't properly reset on death
[*] Sleeping bags and campfires will now properly delete themselves if they are under a foundation
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the foundation to think the workbench was below and thus deleting it. Foundations will never query triggers anymore.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused destroyed sleeping bags that you own not count as your own, giving the player always max sleeping bags even when they have been destroyed
[*] Fixed a bug that caused sleeping bags to delete without giving you the item back when you hit max sleeping bags when placing a new sleeping bag
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hit markers added
[*] Doors can now use alphanumeric keycodes. No longer just digits for added security 
[*] You can now craft clothes in the crafting menu
[*] Items that do not belong in the furnace will now be burnt and turn into Ash
[/list]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Canteen (Dirty Full)
[*] Charcoal Tablets 
[*] Plant Fibers
[*] Ash
[*] Stop Sign Shield (a weaker version than the Riot Shield - Craftable)
[/list]

[h2]Engine[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated to the latest Unity 2021 version, should see a performance increase
[/list]

[h2]Server[/h2]
[list]
[*] Workbenches now have less reason to fail when adding new unauthenticated players to them
[*] Connecting to servers will now asynchronously load map data 
[*] Server should no longer spawn zombies on top of apartment roofs where they get stuck
[*] Server is now twice as fast at deleting items on the ground, for when new loot is being spawned
[*] Significantly reduced networking footprint by ~90%. 90% less bytes in every packet being sent to and from the server. This is huge for server bottle necks and player counts
[*] Due to the massive increase in networking performance, server tick rate has been significantly increased
[*] Disabled Nagle's algorithm

[/list]

[h2]Visuals[/h2]

[h2]Balance[/h2]

notes.title: Nomad 1.0.1.1b Released
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

More rolling updates for 1.0. Today we have reached 1.0.1.1b, we're getting there. I have been focused on getting everything stable. That means working to make sure the server won't bork out, there are no known bugs in the game and least of all, no exploits. 

New content has been slow due to this but I'm happy to announce that there is some new content within this patch. Although it's not as much as I'd like, it's still new. 

I'm looking at once we are stable enough, we will push heavily into new content and features for Nomad.

notes.title: Nomad 1.0b Released
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

Nomad 1.0 is out, meaning we have now hit beta. There are lots of changes, so let's go through them.


[h1]Nomad Premium[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/b82726105b6e1d90bcc6fcb82e1b75438689cf34.png[/img]
Nomad Premium is the ultimate DLC to have, containing but not limited to; 26 Exclusive player skins, Premium gold coloured name tags, Access to /kits, 20+ Death effects when your character dies, Spray your Steam avatar on anything in game and many, many more benefits and features.

[h1]Skin Variety Pack[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/7e88c9dcb6e7793251345c9eb24b3b22dbfcac5a.png[/img]
The Variety Skin Pack is available. This DLC contains 11 new skins for you to flex with inside of the game. Simply change your skin in the customize tab in the main menu.

Buy it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/508800/

[h1]Loot Overhaul & Core Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/1b00dae745770fade6162088a703f964081dfc02.png[/img]
Nomad had a bit of a loot balance problem, there was too much loot spawning within the world making raiding kind of pointless. Why raid a base for their military grade weapons and armour when it was so easy to loot them around the world? 

The total number of loot has been reduced within the world and the spawn timer of loot has increased. This should stagger the amount of military grade weapons, armour and other items in the world where it's actually an incentive to raid other peoples bases for their items.

With this change, it is also more exciting to find higher grade weapons and loot within the world, making the whole experience a whole lot better. 

To counter act this change, there has been 2 new weapons added to the game. Makeshift shotgun and Makeshift Rifle. These weapons cost very few materials to craft (and the ammo) so after you built a base, gathered some mining nodes, you are on your way to create your makeshift weapons.

This should give a better and more natural state of progression in the game in terms of weapon gearing. Spawn > craft bow & arrows > build base > gather mining nodes > decide if you want to upgrade base with new materials of mining nodes or craft makeshift weapons > find & loot higher grade weapons and gear around the world > supply drops.

[h1]Makeshift Rifle[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/56f16e1d0b558ef36b7af3f5624ea5507fe3e9e4.png[/img]
Makeshift rifle is a low cost assault rifle that costs 2 metal and 1 cloth to make. This gun is a starting weapon after building your base.

It uses the new ammo, Scrap Ammo.

[h1]Makeshift Shotgun[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/45fb5d64c10cc00eb19ac5c58c964f839df1ba91.png[/img]
Makeshift shotgun is a low cost shotgun that costs 1 metal and 1 cloth to make. This gun is a starting weapon after building your base.

It uses the new ammo, Scrap Ammo.

[h1]Vehicle Weight[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/21fa9f03f97be8115d71a6fcf4b6362707dfbf51.png[/img]
Gravity in the game has been increased resulting in better handling and proper weights for the vehicles. They handle and perform much better than previous versions.

[h1]New Quests[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/cf80e7eb6cba6dfa939291261a703db6d8b5dec0.png[/img]
With the recent addition of Low Grade Gunpowder and Makeshift weapons comes 3 new quests to complete. Help the safe zone collect gunpowder and deliver your makeshift weapons for an upgraded weapon and rewards.

Hello Survivors,

Patch 0.9.99 is going down well, a lot of people are enjoying it however it's not without its problems. This patch is made to solve those problems.

I've been playing a lot of Nomad recently and I've found a few core problems, not including server related stuff but related to the crafting system. Crafting needs to be sorted out, so this patch aims to address some of these core problems.

Here is what's new, changed and fixed.

[h1]New Crafting Items[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/66c35fedc7a0a439e892f5227785866ba5b7a7e8.png[/img]
A lot of core items are missing from the crafting tab, which makes people having to rely on going out in the world and finding it. This is pretty boring, especially when everything is totally random. 

When you log in, you will now find more crafting options in the crafting tab in the inventory screen. New tools, new food, and more. Some of the older crafting recipes also changed too, for better balance.

Many new food recipes have been added to expand the farming portion of Nomad. These new farming crafted food items are some of the best value food in the game, so be sure to start growing plants!

[h1]Reduced Network Footprint[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/83aec57e9045a28f4f5a47462e22ade783d4feb4.png[/img]
A big source of lag came with how much data Nomad was sending and receiving to each client. I've done some big changes and compressed most data streams so it's not such an impact on the networking side. This should dramatically reduce lag, network spikes and increase client & server performance. 

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes kills you if the server rubberbands you back without finding a position

notes.title: Nomad 0.999.1 Released
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

Nomad 0.999.1 is officially released. This major patch release aims for increased content, cleaner player experience and bug fixes. There's a lot to go through, so let's start.

[h1]DLC Is Here[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/7e88c9dcb6e7793251345c9eb24b3b22dbfcac5a.png[/img]
The Variety Skin Pack is available. This DLC contains 10 new skins for you to flex with inside of the game. Simply change your skin in the customize tab in the main menu.

Buy it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/508800/

[h1]New Settings Screen[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/9165bff461a47efd49e42129b15025ec29784690.png[/img]
The settings window has been completely rewritten and now can be accessed on the main menu. The new settings menu gives you complete full control over the graphics, audio levels and gameplay elements of Nomad. It even comes with ready to use presets to save time going through the many options.

The new settings screen will allow you to control everything in Nomad. It will also help very low end spec PC's to play with a decent frame rate. Below are some comparisons:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/83aec57e9045a28f4f5a47462e22ade783d4feb4.png[/img]
[i]Screenshot taken in game on Ultra settings[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/6ccabc50b527c064c5d0d25ab9fea9e0493e06f2.png[/img]
[i]Screenshot taken in game on Potato settings[/i]

[h1]Legendary Weapons[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/f7b5225ab1196fb5dd4673d51663c64ee1df8385.png[/img]
Legendary Weapons for the Storm, Flamer, Thor, Heckler and Bullpup have been added. These weapons are golden and typically have better stats than the standard counter parts. 

Bullet trails for all weapons have been added but Legendary weapons have a different color bullet trail.

[h1]Meet Saleh, the Armorer[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/d19f46393fd87ddd51ab0c7c4b9fdbdd49c3fa9c.png[/img]
Saleh is a brand new NPC that if you exchange Gold Bars or Safe Zone Tokens, you get to randomly roll on any weapon or armor item. 

There is a small chance of getting legendaries from him, and the only way to get legendary items from the game.

Safe Zone Tokens are acquired by completing quests at Hamood, the quest giver. 

Some accessories will be exclusively obtained via Saleh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/3418b45273f7054d8814fa7a8bdf77d79f9dd2b8.png[/img]

[h1]Accessories[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/e6eca2d15a4d78873f08416a6d340e5ea8bf648d.png[/img]
The bag slot has been replaced with an accessory slot. Accessories give your character increased stats, buffs and cool visual effects and features. Many have been added to the game, so make sure you are on the lookout for them.

Some of the accessories that have been added include, Riot Shield, Backpacks, Cigar, loads of Jewelry including rings and necklaces, and many more!

[h1]Zombies At Night[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/a3473df02751a66bc8afd321fa33fa3b04cb1290.png[/img]
Zombies are more active at night, they will spawn around you every hour. Take shelter, make sure you are ready for the night.

With this change, there are less zombies spawning around major POI's in the day. This gives you time to loot valuable gear outside of your base so you are prepared for the night.

[h1]New Loading Screen[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/63bd9e1754154b45960d7f368afe4d826700b8fe.png[/img]
The loading screen has also been completely overhauled. Tips are displayed at the bottom giving new players a chance to know a bit about the game before they load in. General loading text is now displayed at the top of the loading screen.

[h1]New SUV[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/6e1b1d853d1c4e1d1288ee08508a042ae72a815e.png[/img]
We've added a new variant of the SUV for Free To Play players, this SUV is the same as the Premium SUV, just without the armor. It can be used by both Premium and non Premium players.

[h1]Better Vehicle Handling[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/21fa9f03f97be8115d71a6fcf4b6362707dfbf51.png[/img]
The old vehicle handling was pretty terrible, it was like driving on ice. In this patch, you will find vehicles to handle a lot better.

Vehicles now read from the keybinds, which is a huge plus for anyone who isn't using qwerty keyboards.

[h1]New Resources[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/b4c282ade41db727ea771c39beab1c1c898a65ac.png[/img]
Clay Soil and Clay has been added to the game. Get Clay Soil by using either an axe, pickaxe or a shovel on the ground. Smelt Clay Soil in a furnace to get Clay. Clay is used to smelt Metal and Improved Metal, among others.

Oil Shale and Oil Bottle have also been added. Find Oil Shale by hitting mining nodes around the world, smelt them in a furnace to create Oil Bottle. Oil Bottles can be used to create to Fuel, which is ammo for the Flamer and refuels all vehicles.

Bone Fragments can be found when digging for Clay Soil. Bone Fragments can be crafted into Bone Meal, which helps in the creation of seeds.

[h1]Stackable Resources[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/66c35fedc7a0a439e892f5227785866ba5b7a7e8.png[/img]
This isn't the complete inventory overhaul people wanted but resources can now be stacked by having 5x <item> which combines into a <stacked item>. This will help free up a lot of your storage chests and giving you more space to hold other valuable things.

[h1]Treasure[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/83aec57e9045a28f4f5a47462e22ade783d4feb4.png[/img]
Treasure items have been added to the game. Collect these items around the world and sell them at the trader in the Safe Zone. Works exactly like the Diamond found in mining nodes.

[h1]Increased Inventory and Containers[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/574264856da6f58ac85b936348544e42195a009c.png[/img]
Player inventory size has been increased to 30 slots. Furnace and small storage chest size has been increased to 16 slots and the large storage chest has been increased to 32 slots.

[h1]Updated Physics[/h1]
Nomad now uses the latest Unity Physics technology to help increase your performance and ensures stuff interacts properly. 

[h1]Improved Skybox Visuals[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/3c59910ec23e49aa4cf28baeac208badc043ee69.png[/img]
God Rays, Atmospheric Scattering, better resolution star mapping and cleaning looking nights are just a few things added to ramp up the visuals on Nomad's skybox.

In addition to the visual changes, total day length has been increased to 60 minutes (up from 45 minutes) and night progresses at 1.5x speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/e66f08398471bc9219f9a1a89b1fcf230a7f219d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/42e11a53a5cb77253e5ab82e9f6f95d028a5c556.png[/img]
World fog has been added and gets thicker the lower you are in the world. Fog will blend to the color of the sky.

[h1]Sound Overhaul[/h1]
Bullets and explosions now have reverb. Interaction sounds have been added. In addition, music will now play when loading into a server and in-game.

[h1]Better Anti Cheat[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/c812510bb6d6d7d6f0ee1dee6dfc6fee006930d1.png[/img]
Due to the increased popularity of Nomad we've seen a number of cases involving people abusing the game. With this, we've tightened our anti cheat, obfuscated our code and added server side authentication. We will keep an eye on things from here, ensuring you are free to play without annoying abusers.

[h1]Nomad Month Is Over[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/b82726105b6e1d90bcc6fcb82e1b75438689cf34.png[/img]
Nomad Month is officially over, thanks for celebrating 5 years of Nomad with us!

[h1]Updated Unity[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/229da6616eb22c0ef1907448d7e9432914652c02.jpg[/img]
Nomad has been updated to the latest Unity 2019.4.4f1 LTS to ensure better performance and stability.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
There are a lot of changes, fixes and new stuff that can't possibly fit all here. Below is the entire changelog for this update.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a floating tree
[*] Players logging off inside of a vehicle no longer keeps the player in that vehicle
[*] Added more fall backs to getting external addresses when connecting to a server
[*] Fixed the size of deer blood particle effect
[*] Fixed texture filter on urban body armor icon
[*] Fixed interaction when in map
[*] Flamer bullets will now properly delete and destroy
[*] Fixed a bug that caused servers to not properly spawn vehicles after a certain time
[*] You can no longer access the inventory when chatting in the chat box
[*] Fixed the tooltip on Makeshift Backpack
[*] Fixed missing scripts in the Skin Viewer
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Skin Viewer not to export its default skin texture
[*] Fixed a bug that caused settings in vehicles not to apply instantly
[*] Fixed a bug that caused settings on players to set every frame instead of on change
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player not to load into a server after a second time
[*] Fixed a rare bug that caused the logging into admin overlay to stay active if logging into admin failed 
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Brand new overhauled graphics settings window
[*] Music added
[*] Interaction sounds added
[*] Added reverb to all bullets and explosions
[*] Better anti cheat protection with obfuscation and server side authentication
[*] New vehicle added, the standard SUV. this vehicle is a FTP vehicle and is the same as the Premium SUV without the added armor
[*] New vehicle handling. Vehicles will now be more snappy and grippy when driving
[*] New NPC, Saleh. Located at the Safe Zone and is used to roll for random weapons and armor
[*] Bag slot replaced with Accessory slot. These items enhance player stats and add cool features
[*] Zombies are more active during the night. Zombies spawn everywhere.
[/list]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Wood Stacks added
[*] Stone Stacks added
[*] Metal Stacks added
[*] Improved Stacks added
[*] Gunpowder Stacks added
[*] Sulphur Stacks added
[*] Gem Stone added
[*] Clay Soil item added. Gather this with hatchets, axes or shovels by hitting the ground
[*] Clay item added. Smelt Clay Soil in a furnace to make this item.
[*] Safe Zone Token added. Collect these from completing quests or turning in cash/gold bars
[*] Cigar added
[*] Broken Gold Chain added
[*] Broken Silver Chain added
[*] Luxury Jewellery Box added
[*] Jewellery Box added
[*] Bernard's Watch added
[*] Lunar Amulet added
[*] Mr House's Pocket Watch added
[*] Death's Touch added
[*] Blood Amulet added
[*] Lucky Locket added
[*] Merchant Ring added
[*] Legendary Thor added
[*] Legendary Heckler added
[*] Legendary Storm added
[*] Legendary Flamer added
[*] Legendary Bullpup added
[*] Oil Shale added
[*] Oil Bottle added
[*] Bone Fragments added
[*] Bone Meal added
[/list]

[h2]Engine[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated to the latest Unity 2019.4.4.f1 LTS
[*] Updated physics to use the latest Unity technology
[*] Optimized item objects on the ground
[*] MSAA removed
[*] SMAA added
[*] Better and more efficient zombie culling
[/list]

[h2]Server[/h2]
[list]
[*] Admin command /give is now removed, use the admin menu (F1)
[*] Admin command /heal is now removed, use the admin menu (F1)
[*] Admin command /god is now removed, use the admin menu (F1)
[*] Reduced the number of player network calls per player
[*] 25 vehicles will now spawn across the map over a long duration (20 FTP cars and 5 premium)
[*] Cleaned up server side looting of objects
[*] Better server protection against wall hacks, speed hacks and collision hacks
[*] Quest items are now added to the Admin Items menu under Crafting/Misc
[*] Better optimization with idle vehicles within the world
[*] New and improved player data saving
[*] Better network sync with world time, sky and clouds
[/list]

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] C4 is now listed under weapons in the crafting menu
[*] Crafting menu building tab now has title cards for each section
[*] Food section added to the Crafting menu
[*] Removed the Storage tab from the Crafting menu. All storage crafting items are now found in the Building tab, under Placeables
[*] Revamped the Premium alert box on menu

[*] Bullets now have subtle trails attached to them
[*] Stars are less bright and smaller at night
[*] Flamer bullet visual effects no longer take the entire screen on the first frame
[*] When using a 2 or 3 hit gathering tool, a notification will now appear showing how many hits you have left to gather that resource
[*] When using the incorrect tool to gather a resource a notification will appear telling you that
[*] Added dust particles inside of the Safe Zone building
[*] Updated tree shader and added different colored variants of pine

[*] More items when being crafted will now output what you get when you craft them
[*] Welcome to the Safe Zone chat text now appears when you enter the Safe Zone
[*] Default server image updated to reflect new logo change

[h2]Balance[/h2]

[*] Days are now 60 minutes

[*] Arrows damage reduced to 40, down from 50

[/list]

notes.title: 0.998.19 Released
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

[h1]New DLC[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/7e88c9dcb6e7793251345c9eb24b3b22dbfcac5a.png[/img]
Today I would like to announce a brand new DLC pack for Nomad, The Variety Skin Pack. This DLC contains 10 new skins for you to flex with inside of the game. Simply change your skin in the customize tab in the main menu.

Buy it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/508800/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/508800/[/url]


[h1]A New NPC[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/e5ac0569d5cc05ac1e2e36f0944d16e942ff372c.png[/img]
Meet Rachael, the free items NPC. Rachael is located at the Safe Zone and when you interact with her, she will give you free items. 

You can claim 1 to 4 items every 12 hours.

[h1]Nomad Month[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/b82726105b6e1d90bcc6fcb82e1b75438689cf34.png[/img]
Nomad turns 5 years old this month, Happy Birthday Nomad. We've come so far from the first release and we're super close to final 1.0 release.

Watch the firework display over the Safe Zone in celebration of Nomad Month.

[h1]Iron Mask[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/c812510bb6d6d7d6f0ee1dee6dfc6fee006930d1.png[/img][/h1]
Just like it's bigger counter part, the Riot Shield. The Iron Mask will negate bullets to the head but provides 0% armor. Find the mask in police, industrial or military areas.

[h1]More Quests[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/cf80e7eb6cba6dfa939291261a703db6d8b5dec0.png[/img]
More quests have been added. Quest rewards from previous quests have been rebalanced.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused players not to properly disconnect when failed to join the game server's correct channel
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the server to sometimes not properly connect to its correct game channel
[*] Safe Zone tree is no longer floating
[*] Fixed Stone Foundation health discrepancy
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the inventory to show the incorrect number of items in the inventory
[*] Bullets will no longer collide with clothing items that have colliders on them
[*] Fixed a duping exploit
[*] Fixed a bug that caused mining percentages to +1 on drop rates on mining nodes 
[*] Completing a quest will no longer makes your item count exceed maximum inventory capacity
[*] Ground Control To Major Tom quest item tooltip updated to reflect the actual quest item.
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rachael NPC added, she gives gifts
[*] More quests added
[/list]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Iron Helmet (deflect bullets but provides 0% armor, like its counter part, the Riot Shield)
[*] Diamond. Low chance of getting these at mining nodes to sell for a high price at the Safe Zone
[/list]

[h2]Engine[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enforced UTF8 encoding for all files within Nomad
[*] Player materials upgraded to the Standard shader
[/list]

[h2]Server[/h2]
[list]
[*] Better and more secure Steam authentication when trying to log into admin
[/list]

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] Safe Zone fireworks added for the celebration of Nomad Month
[*] Updated the bleeding and blood particle effects
[*] Updated the explosion effect on C4 and Rockets
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Wooden foundations decay rate decreased to 2 days, down from 4 days
[*] Stone foundations decay rate decreased to 4 days, down from 6 days
[*] Metal foundations decay rate decreased to 6 days, down from 8 days
[*] Improved foundations decay rate decreased to 8 days, down from 14 days
[*] Overall chance of rain reduced, this isn't the UK
[*] Regular zombies health reduced to 50, down from 90
[*] Zombie Brute health reduced to 200, down from 280
[*] Zombie Stalker health reduced to 30, down from 70
[*] Zombie Stalker run speed increased to 14, up from 13
[*] Completing a quest now outputs a message to the entire server, for flexing points
[*] Crossbow bullet speed increased to 250, up from 225
[*] Crossbow bullet damage increased to 60, up from 40
[*] Car spawns increased to 15, up from 10 (10 normal cars and 5 premium SUV's)

[*] C4 crafting materials now only require 1x Explosives, down from 2x Explosives
[*] Mining for Metal Ore now has a 15% chance to be added to your inventory, down from 25%
[*] Mining for Improved Metal Ore now has a 6% chance to be added to your inventory, down from 10%

[*] Mining for Sulphur now has a 8% chance to be added to your inventory, down from 10%
[*] Talented Sulphur now increases your chance to gain Sulphur to 10%, down from 12%
[*] Storage chests can now be placed on top of each other
[*] RPG Rocket damage increased to 10k, up from 9k
[*] Total number of pallets decreased to 40, down from 75
[*] Total number of mining nodes increased to 200, up from 180
[*] Total number of barrels decreased to 100, down from 120
[*] Melee weapon damage enabled within the safe zone. This is due to mining nodes being spawned in the area and prevented mining them. Damage to sleepers can also be done, so don't sleep at the safe zone! Sleep at your base!
[*] Gold Your Horses quest rewards changed
[*] A Personal Quest quest rewards changed
[/list]


[i]Due to the exploit, all servers got wiped.[/i]
