notes.title: Nomad 0.998 Is Back On The Beta Branch
notes.content:
Nomad 0.998.14 is now available on the beta branch on Steam! Upgraded the networking so we need to test things before this goes to live. Yes, it's the vehicles update.

As you know, I had to revert the update due to massive server errors. That's why I upgraded our networking solution and rewrote part of the game. It took a while but it's here.

To join the Nomad 0.998 beta, right click Nomad in your Steam Library > Properties > Betas > Select the beta branch (0.988 beta). Once you've done this, the game will redownload.

Join up, help us test!

notes.title: Nomad 0.998 Is Not Quite Ready
notes.content:
Hello Survivors.

I've been working on a massive update for Nomad, you may have played it. Unfortunately 0.998 isn't quite ready to be released as it has a lot of bugs with it. Mainly issues with the server. This is because I have reworked some of the server networking code. I have reverted the main branch of Nomad back to the stable 0.997 whilst I fix 0.998.

Not sure how long this will take but thanks for playing and letting me know everything that was wrong with the latest patch. Unfortunately stuff like this happens when you are working on stuff alone. 

I'll keep you updated through here and/or on the main discord (which you can join here https://discord.gg/znpKqsb)

Sorry for the trouble!

notes.title: Nomad 0.998 Released. Vehicles, Quests and More!
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors!

The long awaited update 0.998 is now released. This is Nomad's biggest update, ever. There's a lot of content and new features added. Let's go through them:

[h1]Vehicles[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/1a646321617c4a34787c5b5450cc785c3a1bf1e5.jpg[/img]
The much requested feature, vehicles are now added. There are two types of vehicles that spawn in the world, a standard car and a SUV. Only a limited number of vehicles can spawn at any given time, so make sure you're the first to secure them.

Drive them all across the map, you are free to go where ever you want. Vehicles need to be refuelled using Fuel before driving them.

We've added Garage Doors to bases that will help store your vehicles. Protect your vehicle, you found it. Garage Doors can be raided just like any normal base structure. So don't let too many people know about your vehicle being stored at your base, otherwise you'll have quite the number of uninvited guests turning up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/3a2dc64faff55d98889d68b994f0f6a2914c17df.gif[/img]

[h1]Quests[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/cf80e7eb6cba6dfa939291261a703db6d8b5dec0.png[/img]
To enrich the PvE scene, we've added in quests. Quests are picked up at the Safe Zone from the NPC, Hamood.

These quests will take you all over the world finding items, crafting items and killing zombies. Find out about what's happening on the island and uncover history and lore.

Completing quests will give high amount of XP, Cash and mid to end game tier items.

[h1]Meet The Fumer[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/90e9fae0392342164cb67670f0be662292e38344.png[/img] 
A new zombie has been added, The Fumer. This deadly zombie will explode when close, just like her brother, The Boomer but will leave an area of poison gas behind.

You can negate the effects of this toxic gas by wearing a Gas Mask.

Zombies in this update have also been buffed, they will deal more damage, run faster and more of them will spawn. It's safe to avoid Pinewood City and the Airfield until you are heavily geared or with a group of fellow survivors.

[h1]New Safe Zone[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/39ec5f4769551ac07d24f5e64f06a63b888f676b.png[/img]

The Safe Zone has been redesigned and will act as a central hub for all things to come. Traders, Gold Seller and Buyer and the new Quest NPC are stationed here.

Players will spawn in this area and once in the Safe Zone, you cannot be killed.

[h1]Major Locations Redesigned[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/335f37ae1071545a1a792b7e64827752f50203f1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/e9f4994de165b34c1586a8a69a85d027571f51e2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/197bd7b9da17e585744a751fc2d3af7950640ce1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/99419b06d8ec739caa4fac86b577a0ed29efa5c6.png[/img]
Pinewood City, the old military area up north and the Airfield have all been redesigned. They have new, more detailed models and better layouts.

[h1]New Point of Interest, The Lighthouse[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/0ce2f9fb094a084f5ecd67aec8a1b16ff6025f61.png[/img]
A new Point of Interest has been added, The Lighthouse. These lighthouses are jotted in the corners of the world and are fully lootable. They will spawn a range of different gear ranging from medical supplies, military supplies to general supplies. 

Lighthouses show up as pink squares on the map.

[h1]New Keybinding Window[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/1aba55589cf692c0ff151b6a844a9d54b1c31a41.png[/img]
You can now set your key bindings in-game via the pause menu!

[h1]The Riot Shield[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/859cc08b7ea24c65d9abf6aff5704ef7a15aaf88.png[/img]
The Riot Shield has been added. Negate and block incoming fire by wearing this on your back. A great piece of gear to help you win PvP battles.

[h1]Tons of New Items[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/1021e8fd5a7487324e3491c82c7fdcae3cb16465.png[/img]
Tons of new items have been added ranging from Urban Body Armour, a new survival backpack for Premium members to Hockey Masks and more! These items are in the general loot tables and can be picked up anywhere in the world.

4 new Premium skins from the community got added! Remember you can submit your own skins via the Community Hub!

17 new Premium death effects got added. They will play randomly when a Premium player dies. 

[h1]Huge List of Balances and Performance Increases[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/eadb59b7e5e47d1c1a8dd20f7ad8220229b04614.png[/img]
Nomad was pretty unbalanced at the best of times. This update set out to rectify most of the balancing problems.

Zombies are faster, stronger and no longer useless. They pose a threat and should be treated with care.

Talent changes happened. There are now new Level 2 talents to choose from. First option; Decreased to +5% armor, down from 10% and the other will stop 50% of Wet Rating applying to armor.

Most notable balance changes are headshots now do 50% extra damage, down from 100% extra damage and crafting and building XP has been reduced. It's better to earn XP via the new quest system.

Performance upgrades and increases throughout this update will result in better Frames Per Second for a smoother, more enjoyable experience. On average, you should see an increase of around 50% increase FPS.

[h1]Join Our Discord[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9107489/6b3537ce6ffd0c4fe5b817092849eaa74987b984.png[/img]

This patch was released in the Beta branch to everyone on our Discord. If you want to join into previews of future patches, join our Discord at [url=https://discord.gg/FaRbr2P]https://discord.gg/FaRbr2P[/url]

I want to personally thank everyone who tested the beta versions of 0.998. Without your extensive testing, this patch wouldn't be released yet!

We post regularly with news, updates and announcements. Join our community today!

[h1]The Changelog[/h1]
There are a lot of changes, fixes and new stuff that can't possibly fit all here. Below is the entire changelog for this update.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with server list not populating when disconnecting from a server
[*] Fixed a bug where destroyed foundations didn't properly destroy base elements above
[*] Fixed a rare bug that caused the player to not be able to run when reloading weapons
[*] Fixed a bug where the grab timer wasn't working sometimes
[*] Fixed a bug where weapons didn't update fast enough on network players
[*] Fixed a bug with Explosives not properly spawning naturally in the world
[*] Fixed a bug with player kills Steam Achievements
[*] Fixed an inventory exploit
[*] Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't close when failed to authorize with Steam and the player pressed "Exit to Desktop" button
[*] Fixed a rare bug with zombies and deers not interacting with players sometimes
[*] Fixed a rare bug where zombies' targeting may bork out
[*] Fixed a bug where storage chests using didn't instantly update their status
[*] Fixed a bug that caused zombies to play their attacking animation without doing damage some times
[*] Fixed a bug that caused door knock sounds to never properly destroy after it's played
[*] Fixed a bug that caused repair sounds to never properly destroy after it's played
[*] Fixed a bug that caused player animations to sometimes warp
[*] Fixed collision problems with sleepers and player death boxes
[*] Fixed a bug that caused barrels and nodes to share the same number when spawning, causing mismatches in total numbers of nodes and barrels to be spawned
[*] Fixed a bug with server list not showing all of the connected servers
[*] Fixed a bug that caused FPS to be over 60 on the main menu
[/list]

[h2]Engine[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated Unity version, should see some performance increases
[*] Physics Timestep has been increased to 30fps, up from 20fps (40fps in vehicles)
[/list]

[h2]New Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Military Backpack Desert added
[*] Military Backpack Night added
[*] Hockey Mask Blue added
[*] Hockey Mask Brown added
[*] Hockey Mask White added
[*] Survival Backpack added. This special backpack does not spawn in the world nor is it craftable, only Premium users spawn with it.
[*] Urban Ballistic Helmet added
[*] Urban Body Armour added
[*] Vehicle Repair Kit added
[*] Vehicle Repair Kit Recipe added
[*] Garage Doors added
[*] Premium Effects
[*] Added 17 new Premium Death Effects
[*] Added 4 new Premium Skins 
[/list]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] New zombie added, the Fumer. Explodes just like the Boomer but leaves a toxic gas area behind on death (use gas masks to protect yourself from this toxic gas)
[/list]

[h2]World[/h2]
[list]
[*] Southern Military Zone replaced with an Industrial Zone
[*] New Point of Interest, Lighthouse which can spawn all types of gear and loot. They are pink on the map.
[*] Pinewood City redesign (new models, buildings and more)
[*] Airfield redesign
[*] Trader area redesign
[*] Trader area is now a Safe Zone
[*] Added new type of barrel
[*] Military/Weapon pallet added (these are randomly spawned throughout the world)
[*] Stone pallet added (these are randomly spawned throughout the world)
[*] Quests added via an NPC at the Safe Zone. These quests will take you all around the map and are a good source of XP, cash and items when completed.
[*] Vehicles added (a highly requested feature!). Cars will spawn around the world. There is also one premium car added which is locked to premium users only which boasts better speeds, health, handling and is all wheel drive.
[/list]

[h2]Server[/h2]
[list]
[*] New server technology and better server console (you can type in commands at the server console - a much requested feature)
[*] New robust item spawner to handle the hundreds of loot objects in the world
[*] Added more words to the profanity filter
[/list]

[h2]Anti-Cheat[/h2]
[list]
[*] A lot of fixes, improvements and changes to the Anti Cheat system
[*] Workbenches are now more secure when accessing or changing authorizations
[*] Storage chests and containers are now more secure when accessing or interacting with them
[/list]

[h2]Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Performance increases with player movement packets to the server
[*] Decreased memory footprint of each player connected
[*] Increased performance with C4 explosions
[*] Zombie targeting packets has been significantly reduced
[*] Zombie targeting performance has been significantly increased
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Admin Menu is now rebindable in the Input Tab on the launcher
[*] Night Vision Toggle is now rebindable in the Input Tab on the launcher
[*] You can now hide the UI by pressing F2 (default).
[*] Main Menu now displays summary of patch notes and other news articles listed in boxes
[*] New Keybinding window on the pause menu. You can now change your keybinds in-game.
[*] There is now a popup advertisement for Premium on the main menu screen for free to play users. Help support the game, get Premium!
[/list]

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] Barrel model replaced
[*] Gas Mask model replaced
[*] Military Ballistic Helmet model replaced
[*] Zombie Boomer texture changes
[*] NPC's now have nameplates above their heads
[*] Door UI tooltip wording changed
[*] Bloom intensity reduced
[*] Premium Death effects are now larger
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Headshots now do 50% increased damage, down from 100%
[*] Rebalanced XP from items, crafting and kills
[*] It now takes longer to level up (Premium players will still benefit from 50% experience gain)
[*] Zombie Brutes now have 300 hp, up from 200
[*] Zombie Stalkers now have increased run speed
[*] Zombie Stalkers health increased to 80 hp, up from 60 hp
[*] Zombie Boomer explosion damage increased to 70 hp, up from 45 hp and blast radius increased to 7m, up from 5m
[*] Zombie Boomer explosion damage is now 2x more effective against other zombies
[*] Zombie Boomer health increased to 90 hp, up from 60 hp
[*] Zombies health increased to 110 hp, up from 80 hp
[*] All clothing items armor values have been rebalanced. Each slot can go to a maximum of 10% based on the quality of the item. 50% in total
[*] Workbenches now protect an area in an capsule, not a cube
[*] Increased currency you get from first time killing and repeat killings to 100-15, up from 75-10
[*] Level 4 Armor Talent decreased to +5% armor, down from 10%
[*] Level 4 Talent changed. This talent will stop 50% of Wet Rating applying to armor
[*] The Wet effect rating increased to -40% armor, up from -30%
[*] Level 2 Talents changed. Increase food value or increase drink value.
[*] All players now spawn at the Safe Zone as this will act as a hub in future
[*] Reduced the number of total mining nodes in the world
[*] Reduced the number of total barrels in the world
[*] Reduced the number of total pallets in the world
[*] Non-owners can now upgrade doors
[*] Player death box collision removed
[/list]

notes.title: 0.9974 Is Now Live! Halloween Update 2019
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

This year I decided to add some cool items into Nomad for Halloween 2019 as I missed it last year. 

A magical wand has been added to the game as a weapon. All players will start with this. Gather the ammo from zombies!

A new witch hat also got added to the game, all players will start with this too. It's 8% armour and is in tune with the Halloween theme.

All previous Halloween items have been enabled, such as a Pumpkin shoes and Pumpkin head!

Along with the new Halloween items, some core bug fixes also happened. Changelog below:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with bans sometimes not properly kicking the player off the server
[*] Added better functionality when logging into the admin panel
[*] Added better checks for when a player is inside of a spawned object
[*] Reduced flamer damage on wooden structures
[*] C4 will now only affect 1 structure element, no more taking out multiple elements by placing on corners
[*] Fixed a tooltip error when trying to upgrade wooden foundations
[*] Rebalanced talents
[*] You can no longer damage stone structures with weapons. Use C4 or rockets to destroy them.
[*] Updated traffic cone icon
[*] Added Halloween 2019 Witch Hat 
[*] Halloween items are now enabled 
[*] Wand weapon added (Halloween 2019 item)
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused C4 to do more damage than intended
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player to drop through foundations and ceilings
[/list]

Official servers have [b]not [/b]been wiped due to this update.

Keep up to date with news by joining our Discord server at: [url=https://discord.gg/znpKqsb]https://discord.gg/znpKqsb[/url]

notes.title: Nomad 0.997 Released!
notes.content:
Hello survivors! 

Nomad 0.997 is now released, however as the last build contained a lot of bugs and exploits, this update came early. Due to this, vehicles are not included in this version.

Vehicles are around 50% completed and was originally planned for this update, but due to the bugs and exploits, 0.997 had to be released early.

Changelog:
- Fixed a bug that prevented players from looting farmable crops
- Roads added
- Bloom effect reduced
- Updated tonemapping effect
- Main menu redesigned
- Main menu connection fixes
- Bullet speed on all bullets are now 20% faster
- Discord rich presence added
- Fixed a bug that caused bullets not to do the proper damage on metal and steel doors
- Fixed a bug that caused bullets to do double damage or sometimes triple damage on objects and players
- Wooden and stone tier base armor value increased by 50% (armor does not affect flamer damage or explosive damage)
- Fixed a bug that caused durability stacks on your weapon from other peoples weapons
- Fixed zombie explosion positioning (was spawning on the ground level)
- Server and client script optimizations
- Loot will now slowly spawn over time instead of spawning in one go
- Fixed a bug with looting items with raycasting
- Fixed a bug with mining talents not correctly getting sulphur or improved metal
- Fixed a bug that caused extra mining nodes to spawn when mining
- Increased rock durability
- Explosive zombies explosions now affect objects around them (and other zombies!)
- Fixed hands durability bug
- Added better protection for dedicated server client to start when loading a server
- Bullets can no longer go through tiny openings (base doors)
- New weapon added, Kuzi. A high rate of fire uzi, uses 9mm ammo boxes.
- Gold bars are now worth $250. This will help store cash.
- Premium members now gain 50% extra XP
- Weapon speed and damage adjusted on some weapons 
- Lyno is no longer a single fire weapon
- Fixed stairs from deleting itself when placed at the side of a foundation
- Added new status effect, wet. Being wet will reduce your armor by 30%
- Explosive and stalker zombies now have increased health
- Compass added that displays NESW heading
- Pocket Pistol now holds 9 bullets, up from 6
- Replaced Painkillers model
- Replaced Military Backpack model
- Fixed a chat display bug when using the admin cleaning tools
- Fixed a bug that caused furnace decay to run much slower than usual
- Added harsher server checks for all containers
- Placing objects now check for intersecting objects in the way
- Sleeping bags can now be placed in unauthorized areas
- Wooden spike traps can now be placed in unauthorized areas
- Fixed a bug with wooden spike trap culling and positioning
- Fixed a bug that caused birds to give multiple sets of XP
- Supply helicopters now spawn every 45 minutes, up from 15 minutes
- Supply helicopters will now be announced in the chat when they spawn
- Supply helicopters and supply drops now have map icons
- Player boxes now stay for 10 minutes, up from 5 minutes
- Supply drops now stay for 15 minutes, up from 5 minutes
- Fixed a bug that caused the supply helicopter not to spawn
- Thor, C4 and Explosives are now added in the supply drop loot table
- Traffic cone hat added
- Rebalanced hats armor values
- Supply helicopter now waits 1 minute before dropping its load. More chance of people catching up to it when it drops
- Optimized netcode (>50% reduced bandwidth)
- Construction objects no longer push players

All servers have been wiped due to this update.

Keep up to date with news by joining our Discord server at: https://discord.gg/znpKqsb

notes.title: Nomad 0.996 Is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

As you know, I've been working on the latest version of Nomad for quite some time. I needed this version to be tested, that's why it was on a beta branch. Why did it need to be tested? Because of the new dedicated server.

The new dedicated server will solve the current issue of latency and ping. Before, Nomad was running on a relay server, not good! This means whoever was the first one to connect or be the "master client", it meant that person was the server. If the person was located in another country, you are tied to that location.

Not anymore! With the new dedicated server, where ever the server is located IS the location of the server. The server also handles all game logic too, making huge performance increases for players who was currently hosting the game.

To server owners. There is no NomadServer.exe anymore. Simply run Nomad.exe using -batchmode (or simply run the RUN SERVER.bat file) to start the server. More details on how to use the server is located in the Server Documentation folder, found in your install directory.

ZOMBIES HAVE RETURNED! Zombies are stronger and faster than ever before. This means you can't simply run into high tier loot areas such as Pinewood City, Military Island or the Airfield anymore. Be sure to loot SMALLER areas of the map first. You need to be prepared, geared and having a few friends to around to protect you always helps.

A lot of other stuff got changed and added too. Below is the massive changelog of my work over the months.

Enjoy!

Changelog:

NEW: 
- Dedicated Server (No more relay server) This will finally solve the lag and ping issue
- Loot system has changed, no more rarity rating. Everything is completely random. There are still loot tables for Point of Interests though
- The new loot system also spawns weapons with 0,1 or 2 ammo boxes beside them
- Zombies have returned. They are faster and stronger than ever. They spawn around Pinewood, Military Island and Airfield.
- Airfield Point of Interest added
- Players will no longer explode on death. Instead a box or bag will drop containing the players loot
- Premium members can spray their avatars around the map (t to spray)
- Spawn and death effects for Premium members
- Added view distance in options
- Decay system 2.0. now includes traps, barricades, campfires and furnaces
- Steam Authentication
- New terrain textures
- New trees
- New campfire model
- Replaced super old post processing shaders with new up to date shaders

CHANGED:
- Updated unity to latest version
- Updated scripting runtime version to .NET 4
- Quality of life changes; You can now move whilst in the inventory. You can now move whilst drinking/eating/healing
- Replace old shitty city area with more detailed city (think Pinewood from old school map)
- New hit sound effects
- Updated default fall back server image on servers that didn't specify a server.png file
- Supply crate, bandage and ammo box have new models
- Enter (return key) now works for chat
- Admin login system will now use Steam ID's listed in Admin.txt rather than using a password
- You can now use /kits and /kit to redeem kits (if you are premium)
- Added /server command to the list of commands
- Fine tune safe zone building areas
- Updated muzzleflash for weapons
- Updated bullet effects
- Smoothed terrain in places
- Supply crates (air drop crates) now delete after 10 minutes
- Physics system is now running at 60fps, instead of 15fps
- Supply crates will now give better loot and guaranteed 2 recipes or more
- The game now disconnects and exits to main menu much faster
- Fog has been added
- Buffed wooden structures by 15%
- XP from upgrading and building reduced by 40%
- Zombies step height increased
- Zombies are slightly weaker
- Zombies will now spawn every 10 minutes, instead of instantly after death
- Zombies no longer push players
- Adjustments to ambient color
- Tonemapping added
- C4 and rockets no longer spawn in the world
- Fixed bug with item spawner spawning in disabled items
- Day and night sound effects added
- Sky adjustments
- All points of interests are now marked on the map
- Increased the maximum view distance to 1600, up from 1000
- Updated server documentation
- Minigun, Bow and Crossbow damages increased

FIXED:
- Fixed bug with server disconnecting/bugging out on server kicks
- Objects can float in the air when bases are decayed/deleted
- Cursor showing through map, menus and inventory
- IndexOutOfRangeException on concrete/stone sounds
- Anti cheat not correctly executing some functions (banning people etc)
- Weird bug where players couldn't shoot after switching weapons too fast
- Achievements not working
- Muzzleflash gameobjects not deleting when being told to
- Opening inventory/escape menu/options menu or chat window when falling will negate all fall damage
- Inventory not updating when reloading weapons
- Workbenches can sometimes bypass the "inside of an object" check
- Using shotguns can rarely disable muzzleflashes for all weapons
- Rare bug where melee weapons can be "aimed"
- Blood particle leaves behind weird hovering texture particles
- RPG Rockets sometimes not doing damage
- Fixed Unity Warnings, phantom missing scripts and optimized multiscene
- Fixed inventory exploit
- Fixed trader selling 0 priced items
- Fixed bug with zombies only attacking once
- Fixed chat box not disappearing after no new messages
- Fixed skybox banding
- Fixed stars alignment and transition effects
- Hangar model now correctly emits bullet effects

notes.title: 0.991 Patch Notes + Experimental Branch
notes.content:
Long time no see survivors!

0.991 is live on the experimental branch for testing. Anyone who wants test this version will opt in via the properties menu and selecting the "BETA's" tab. There you will find the branch, experimental.

notes.title: 0.98 Patch Notes (Biggest Update Yet!)
notes.content:
To prevent any errors in this patch, ALL servers have been wiped.

NEW: 
- You can now refill waterbottles and canteens at water towers around the map
- All crafting items are now inventory items. No more instantly crafting and using via the crafting tables
- New Deer model
- Moose added
- Doe added
- Only players who have built base elements can now destroy them, only inside of an authorised building area. This stops raiders placing down workbenches outside of none workbenched bases and instantly raiding them. This also stops raiders from accessing workbenches and destroying the entire base instantly.
- New scope and scope system have been added to all scoped weapons.
- New supply drop system added
- New /maxping command, showing what the max ping on the server is
- New weapon added, Crossbow
- New Safe Zone added
- New kill feed added
- Added Twitch and Patch Notes to the main menu
- New Official Nomad South Africa server has been added. More regions soon!
- You can now scrap all head items for cloth
- New /airdrop command - spawn an airdrop (admin command only)
- New currency system added
- New /server command has been added (outputs the name of the server you are connected to)

CHANGED:
- All food and drink items now give more hunger and thirst
- Using a medical pack now gives more health
- C4 damage increased to 33,335, up from 25,500
- Rocket damage increased to 12,500, up from 10,000
- Wooden base elements health increased to 20,000, up from 12,500
- Wooden shutters health increased to 1,250, up from 750
- Foundations are now 100% stronger than normal base elements
- Cardboard elements health increased to 10, up from 5
- Large storage chest model size has been decreased
- Pocket Pistol damage increased to 18, up from 15
- Block 19 damage increased to 20, up from 18
- Wooden Foundations now decay in 4 days, up from 2 days
- Stone Foundations now decay in 8 days, up from 3.8 days
- Metal Foundations now decay in 14 days, up from 8.3 days
- All Barricades have decreased LOD and culling
- First talent in Level One, bandages now increase hp by 15, up from 10
- Inventory and crafting UI has no opacity and has been touched up
- Added V for voice chat in the /help commands
- All weapons are now better positioned
- Notifications text will now scale inside of the bounding box 
- UI Crafting text will now scale inside of the bounding box
- RPG and C4 damage radius increased to 15 units, up from 11
- Barrels no longer drop items of worth, it made the game way too easy to find high tiered gear
- Saw damage decreased to 21, down from 23
- Magnum damage decreased to 28, down from 30
- Total number of deer has been increased to 40, up from 30
- Scare radius on deers/stags/does have been decreased to 100 units, down from 600
- Ladders can now be used in unauthorised building areas
- Heavy Pickaxe and Heavy Axe extra gathering rate has been decreased to 33%, down from 50%
- Bolt scope zooms in more than the Thor sniper scope now, but Bolt has less damage
- Crosshairs now disable when aiming with all weapons
- Crosshair changed
- Changed all pistol animations
- Optimized network player animations
- Inventory automatically saves every 10 minutes, up from 5 minutes
- Weather system will now have less chance to be foggy
- Server will now check and respawn zombies every 10 minutes, up from 5 minutes.
- All barricades' health have been increased
- Updated to Unity 5.5.2f1
- Changed supply drop loot table
- Removed Medical supply drop
- Supply drops will now drop all items on the floor before deleting, instead of just deleting
- Zombies will now go back to their starting position after losing aggro
- Increased VOIP quality to Speex 16k, up from Speex 8k
- Map changes
- Removed nature particle effect from map
- Supply drops no longer drop in the desert
- Barrels will now reset every 30 minutes
- All animation will now cull when off the camera
- Changed how lighting culling works
- Tighter checks for floating objects
- Nights are now a little brighter
- Rabbit traps now have a 33% chance to break
- Player width and height colliders have been increased
- Supermarket recoloured
- Scrapping a crowbar no longer gives wood, instead it gives metal
- Text when failed to recieve scrap material from scrapping has changed to "<itemname> has broke"
- Stone Pickaxe and Stone Axe now require 1x wood and 1x stone to craft
- Minigun is now far more accurate
- Minigun aiming accuracy increased
- Decreased the time it takes to gather berries from bushes
- Tusten changed
- Changed player spawn locations. Only can spawn randomly at Pinewood beach or High Beach
- You can now build at southern beaches
- Water no longer teleports the player 
- /help command changed
- Hunting bow now only fires 1 arrow per ammo
- Arrows are now Arrow and are single shots per item
- Crafting Arrows now give 2 arrows per wood
- Large storage chest now requires the large storage chest recipe
- Nomad servers will now generate a secure admin password if the password is "password" or "admin" - We have seen a lot of community servers leaving their admin passwords as default.

FIXED:
- Fixed the water bug near the back of the quarry
- Fixed known floating bushes and trees
- Fixed LOD on all tiers of window base elements
- Fixed zombie loot tables
- Fixed Workbench territory names from being blank
- Fixed the ability to change territory name when not authorised
- Fixed second talent in Level 1, bandages were healing
- Fixed workbench sometimes deleting itself
- Fixed firing current weapon when clicking off the server welcome screen
- Pressing escape when placing objects will no longer eat the resource/s
- Storage chests when breaking will now play the destruction effect
- Campfires when breaking will now play the destruction effect
- Fixed rare bug where players were waking up at someone elses sleeping bag
- Fixed rare bug where players could destroy bases regardless of workbenches and authorization
- Fixed road LOD and culling errors
- Fixed scare radius on deers sometimes not firing when player gets too close
- Fixed mip map issues with items, trees and bushes
- Fixed door LOD and culling issues
- Fixed text lag on signs
- Bullets no longer collide with the sky
- Fixed Skin Viewer material
- Fixed sync issues with MOTD
- Fixed zombies sometimes not targetting players when close
- Fixed /timeset command output text
- Fixed supply drop health displaying 250% 
- Fixed shooting with automatic weapons in menus/building mode
- Fixed Dew Catcher text
- Fixed Barricade text
- Fixed Deer death lag
- Fixed planting seeds and inventory slots not updating
- Fixed /kill adding to player kills
- Crouch height issue has been fixed
- Fixed capitals usage in all commands

notes.title: 0.90 Patch Notes - Talents - XP System - Recipes and More!
notes.content:
[h1]XP System[/h1]
In Nomad 0.90, there is a brand new XP system. You can earn XP for killing zombies, deers, crafting certain items and finding loot around the world. The max level is 5.

[h1]Introducing Talents[/h1]
With the brand new XP system, there is also a Talent system. Every time you gain a level, you can select 1 out of 2 talents available for that level. These talents range from 15% damage, bandages will now heal, increased run speed and many more! You can find the new talent system under Talents in the inventory menu

[h1]Recipe System[/h1]
There are now recipes to find around the world. These recipes will unlock different crafting items in your crafting menu.

[h1]Barrels[/h1]
Random barrels will now spawn around the world. Destroy these with a melee weapon or a range weapon to gain random loot and random recipes. Destroying barrels is the only way to get recipes.

[h1]New Main Menu[/h1]
A brand new main menu has been added to make the menu of Nomad much cleaner. Hope you guys enjoy!

[h1]Friendly Reminder[/h1]
As so much stuff was changed and added this patch, you may run into game breaking bugs. If you do happen to run into a bug, please post it on the community forum or joining the Nomad Discord (linked in-game). Please do not add me to Steam and tell me directly, use the community forum or discord. Thank you!

[h1]Complete Changelog for 0.90[/h1]
I have added much more to 0.90, read below to find exactly what was added.

- fixed problem with bugged sleepers
- optimized loading of sleepers
- saving character changes in the backend
- zombies have a new death particle
- fixed zombie death ragdoll spawning location issue
- zombies now explode on death
- brand new main menu added
- xp system added (crafting or killing zombies and deers will give xp) 
- talent system added (find this under the inventory menu)
- destroying a foundation will now delete ladders attached to that foundation/walls
- changed font on in game menu
- new workbench menu added
- you can no longer overlap workbenches
- setting the weather via the admin menu will now output a message on click
- increased the timeout to 4 minutes for older PCs that take long to connect to a server
- new premium skin added, Hobo (by Steam user Salty Bill)
- skin editor will now show you what side is the front and back of the character (F/B)
- supply drops will now delete after closing the crate on first time opening
- changes to storage chests on closing to ensure player has properly left storage chest
- recipes added - find these around the world in barrels, they unlock crafting abilities - they do not reset on death
- barrels added, contains random loot and recipes (destroy them with melee or range weapon - bare hands don't work)
- mining nodes will no longer try and spawn when disconnecting from the server (lol)
- new navigational mesh to provide higher quality AI pathfinding
- medical pack is now craftable
- optimized all barricade colliders
- new object distance check added to help prevent floating objects after a base has been destroyed
- new error outputs if building pieces fails to attach to base
- adjusted inventory item name text to best fit items with longer names
- death timer decreased to 10 seconds, down from 45 secs


Nomad Official servers have been wiped due to this update. It is also very important to wipe your Users folder and Server.dat when upgrading if you are a server owner.

notes.title: 0.58 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This update brings changes to the military zones, towns and more control for server owners.

Lakeview and both north and south military zones have been deleted and replaced with a large military area where Lakeview used to be. This will bring players to one area to find the best loot and pvp, instead of splitting players in half.

There is new control for server admins with MOTD's and Kits. Please see motd.txt and kits.txt for more information. There is also an item list in the documentation.

Kits are disabled by default, so make sure to set it to True in the server-config.txt

All Nomad Official servers have been wiped due to this update. It is highly recommended that ALL server owners should wipe their servers for this update.

Full changelog:
- scrapping ammo chance reduced from 20% to 10%
- scrapping a hunting bow will no longer give metal
- fixed a inventory dupe bug with tooltip error
- mining nodes are no longer deleted on first start up
- remove hammer will now remove metal doors
- /clearall and /clear is now /invclearall and /invclear for server admins
- fixed loot spawning
- added /wipeall which clears all loot items, empty campfires/furnaces and respawns loot
- better unloading the level on disconnect
- fixed twitch message alert box
- c4 now affects campfires
- fixed terrain bug near the southern super market
- removed lakeview town
- removed both military areas
- added one giant miliary area where lakeview was
- saw max ammo is now 50, down from 100
- fixed default password lockout
- light performance increase on campfires, furnaces and torches
- all light sources have increased flicker intensity, to emulate real life flames
- added Message Of The Day to the server. see motd.txt
- added MOTD timer to the server config
- added kits to the server - do /kit to redeem
- added allow kits in server config to turn kits on or off
- TULA fire sound effect is now reduced
- TULA muzzle light fixed

notes.title: New Servers + Recruiting Admins
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that High Loot 2 has been opened due to a high number of players playing High Loot 1.

If you are itching for a challenge in Nomad, you'd be pleased to know we have released a Hardcore server. The server has increased zombies, zombie health and damage has been increased and the loot has been set to low.

We are also recruiting a handful of admins for the official servers, to help clean  up raided bases, ban cheaters and keep the servers in a friendly manner. 

For more information about being an admin, go here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/378370/discussions/0/364041517009417887/

Cheers,

notes.title: 0.52 Patch Notes + Big Changes To Servers
notes.content:
This patch focues on small bug fixes and major changes to the server files. All server owners will need to use the new server.exe and .bat file in order to make it work with the current version of the game.

NOTE: All servers MUST be wiped and the new servers cannot use old server.dat files. This is due to the changes we have made to the server and therefore incompatiable with the new version.

Here is the complete changelog for 0.52:

- fixed lag problem when someone joins
- optimized player scripts
- fixed chat box scrolling
- player nametags are back
- fixed server admin nametag
- added /mute <name> for server admins
- increased mining nodes (total 220 mining nodes in map)
- new server: you can now control number of slots & client version & password in the start.bat
- all servers will need to be wiped before joining due to the new server tech
- fixed inventory on death
- possible fix for server menu not loading
- game window is now resizable when playing in window mode
- added new documentation to the server folder

notes.title: 0.51 Patch Notes (New Inventory/Crafting System + More!)
notes.content:
PLEASE NOTE: Nomad has a brand new inventory and crafting system. This brand new and had very -little- testing done on it. Although everything was working in the development stage, you may see some bugs or some glitches with it. Please, if you find any bugs or problems with the inventory system leave a message on the community forums so I can fix ASAP.

Here is the full changelog of 0.51 beta:

- tree shadows should now appear
- reduced the number of ores that spawn
- made a new ore spawner that controls the total number of ores in the map
- deleted quarry
- new inventory screen
- all containers now use the new inventory screen (sleepers, furnace, chests and campfires)
- c4 will now properly destroy when placed
- you can now scrap all bags, weapons, farming items, ammo, shoes and bandages
- all item tooltips/descriptions have been updated
- fixed supply drops
- fixed sleeper texture
- fixed losing of items when you crash or drop connection from the server
- opening loot boxes (ammo boxes and winter presents) will now go straight into your inventory instead of spawning around you
- medical packs and painkillers now restore more health
- fixed loot spawning when you die
- added /clearall for server admins which will clear all inventory and equipped items
- supply drops now drop every 20 minutes, up from 15 minutes
- increased wooden structures health to 7500, up from 3000
- increased wooden barricades health (small and large)
- fixed c4 explosions having an error when the player wasn't spawned
- fixed zombies sometimes going into god mode
- fixed interacting with metal structures (you can now repair them & displays health)
- servers now display IP and port
- server menu changed
- you can no longer build structures on beaches
- you can now log out in building areas, regardless of being authorised or not
- changed the way workbenches work, you can now overlap different workbenches
- added a new "building granted" and "building denied" tooltip to the UI
- optimized fires and lighting
- splint now requires cloth instead of a bandage to craft
- large storage chest now requires 1 metal instead of 2
- you can no longer craft the fireaxe or pickaxe
- removed player names above characters heads (this will return if people miss this feature)
- fixed stick

notes.title: All Official Servers Have Been Wiped
notes.content:
It's that time again where the official servers are over loaded by raided bases and other random crap players leave behind when playing Nomad. 

When there is a very high number of these raided bases/items and objects left behind by players, FPS and performance takes a hit. As well as building space on the map.

For this reason, we wipe servers to ensure high performance and to delete all the clutter.

If you are hosting a Nomad server, you can wipe your server by deleting the Server.dat file located in your server folder. You should do this every now and again.

notes.title: Server Wipe and More!
notes.content:
Hello Nomads!

Both Nomad Official High Loot and Normal Loot servers will be scheduled for a wipe. This means your base, items and character will be deleted.

Why do we do this? We do this to clean up unused items that players have spawned in the world. If you look around both servers, you will see a large number of unused/raided bases.

Also, when you exit Nomad and log off your character sleeps on the floor. This means other players can walk to your sleeping body and loot it! They can even kill you. 

I've seen many negative reviews saying they have lost their character when they have logged off. This is probably due to the fact that you were killed in your sleep.

notes.title: Stats and 2016 Roadmap
notes.content:
Since Nomad came to Steam on the 26 Jun 2015, we have done 38 updates containing 542 changes, fixes and new additions (that's on average 1.5 updates per week). We have already done everything on the list from the first roadmap. It's been a very successful period for us on Steam. Like always, the development process is being streamed on Twitch at www.twitch.tv/bluemurdergaming

So what's next for us? Here is a small Roadmap for 2016.

Nomad is still in alpha and will push into Beta at 0.5 and onwards. We're close, we're at 0.46.

- Clothes. I want more sets of clothes in the game which range from makeshift clothes crafted from hide/leather/cloth, up to beef'd up military gear. I also want to add more crazy and odd clothing items such as a rabbit hats, the giant pig head and more.

- Backpacks. More backpacks in the game, we only have around 7 in the game now. I think it will be cool to see more

- Vehicles. A highly, highly requested feature and this will come after we push into beta. I want quad bikes, cars, pickups trucks and more. I'm also toying with the idea of having helicopters in which you need to repair first before you fly.

- Weapons. I want to completely re-do the -entire- collection of weapons we have. Completely remodel them so they fit in the world of Nomad. This means having a weapon such as the KA-74 to look more rusty and old. Right now all weapons look pristine. This is something I want to change.

- Building. I want to add more building modules for players. Having triangle shaped foundations to shape your buildings better. Window bars, ramps, roofs, chimneys and more.

- Upgrading buildings. You can go from cardboard to wood to stone at the moment. I want to add in metal buildings, reinforced metal buildings and so on. Each time you upgrade, it takes more C4 to blast through.

- Skins. Another highly requested feature. The ability to change the default skins and play whatever you want.

- Farming. Revisit the farming feature and add more to it. Simple as that.

- Mining. I think it'll be cool to craft mining machines that will mine for you. So I'll be looking into this.

- Reputation system. Finish the rep system so we can have bandit and hero safe zones which act like a hub for the world.


Thank you for supporting and playing Nomad.

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: 0.45 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Big changes to Nomad in 0.45. This patch was developed on stream at www.twitch.tv/bluemurdergaming

[h1]Trees, Grass, Foliage and Rocks[/h1]
Bushes has been added to the game. You can collect different coloured berries at them. All berries do something different. Trees have been updated and now move in the wind. Grass will now fade at distance. Rocks and big mountains have been added around the map

[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
Furnace, sleeper, chest and other scripts have been optimized which should provide better FPS in game. You can also press ESC when on a sleeper/furnace/chest to close the menu (no need to press EXIT!)

[h1]New Options[/h1]
New options have been added to the game. You can now control texture quality and pixel light count to help performance.

[h1]Resources[/h1]
Gathering resources when chopping down trees or mining will make the resource item go straight into your inventory. You no longer need to pick up the item on the floor.

[h1]The Rock[/h1]
All players will start with a rock. This rock can be used as a weapon and a resource gatherer. Simply smash your rock on a tree or a mining vein to gather the resource. The rock requires 3 hits to gather. Fireaxes and Pickaxes require only 1 hit.

[h1]New Weapon[/h1]
A new pistol has been added to the game, Pocket Pistol. The Pocket Pistol takes .25 ACP ammo and can be found in police stations, houses and military areas.

[h1]Ghillie Suits[/h1]
Ghillie suits have been added to the game and can be found only in military areas.

[h1]A Map[/h1]
A map has been added and can be accessed by pressing "M" in game. This map is still very prototype so appearance/looks of it will change later.

[h1]New Status Effects[/h1]
2 new status effects have been added. Sickness and Poison. Eating raw meat, infected meat or whole dead birds will cause sickness. Sickness cannot be cured and lasts 10 minutes. While sick, your food and thrist will decrease faster and all food items are 50% less effective. Poison will cause you to slowly lose health and can be only cured by using an antidote. You can find antidotes in medical areas, or in your crafting menu.

[h1]New Food And Drink Items[/h1]
Cypher Cola and Can of Cashews have been added to the game. Delicious!

[h1]Reputation (first pass)[/h1]
Reputation has been added. Gain reputation over time or lose 200 reputation when you kill someone. Reputation does nothing at the moment but will be used for Hero and Bandit Safe Areas later down the line. You can see your reputation in inventory > stats (under the picture of your character)

[h1]Complete Changelog[/h1]
We added so much more to this update. Here is the complete changelog:

- server menu changed slightly
- player UI changed slightly
- trees move in the wind
- grass now fades in
- inventory script optimized
- structure upgrade/repair GUI optimized
- furnace script optimized
- small/other script optmizations
- furances now have 50hp, down from 350hp
- workbenches now have 100hp, down from 200hp
- you can now change texture quality in options menu
- you can now change pixel light count in options menu
- brand new loot spawner system and loot tables - now based on rarity when spawning - needs feedback
- bolt is now back in the game and spawns in military only
- hitting trees/stones/metal ore veins will make the resource go straight into your inventory. it no longer spawns in the world.
- bushes added
- you can search for berries (4 different types) at bushes
- fixed katana damage
- new weapon, rock has been added to game and works as a axe and a pickaxe however it takes 3 hits to get the resource (all players start with this item now)
- all bullets have been rebalanced
- pocket pistol added to the game
- new ammo type, .25 acp
- you can craft the ammo .25 acp in crafting > ammo
- deer blood updated
- all particles updated
- welcome message added
- server config now splits at ":" and not " " (spaces). all spaces after ":" will be removed so use "_" instead (for passwords etc)
- new commands for server admins, /clear (clears inventory) - also listed in /help
- hosting a server in game now shows on the server list
- zombies now uses the proper send functions and should now properly send to everyone (network messages)
- deer AI optimized
- rocks have been added around the map
- bag items now show bag slots in the tooltip
- fixed black and white filter when damaged
- fixed player names above players
- fixed dead bird item name
- added a ghillie suit which spawns only in military
- new supporter color (if you have supported the stream (twitch.tv/bluemurdergaming), your name is now in green)
- server admin color is now red
- new player status "sickness" (reduces food and thrist of food/drink items by 50% and also increases the rate you lose hunger and thrist by 100%) - sickness is incurable, you must wait 10 minutes for it to wear off 
- eating raw bird meat, venison and raw zombie meat will now give you sickness
- drinking spoiled milk will give you sickness
- new player status, "poisoned" - take damage when poisoned - curable only by antidote
- added antidote which is craftable under medical items (inventory > crafting > medical) and also spawns in medical and military areas
- player names are now coloured if you are a dev or a supporter (name above character)
- removed status from inventory screen (as icons on the HUD show that status effects are on you)
- added map (press m to open)
- can of cashews added
- cypher cola added
- you can now press esc on furnaces/chests/sleepers to close the window
- reputation added and can be found under INVENTORY > STATS (on the main inventory page) (this is the first pass and doesnt actually do anything right now)

notes.title: 0.42 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This update fixes a lot of stuff, adds a new weapon and a whole lot more.

[h1]KA-74 [/h1]
A new weapon has been added to Nomad, the KA-74. We all can guess what it is... It is located in police stations and military areas. It also comes with a new ammo type, 7.62mm

[h1]AI Changes [/h1]
All AI should now be sync'd. That means when you log off from the server, the position of the zombies and the deers will be saved. So the next time you log on, they will be in the same place (if nobody else aggro'd them)

[h1]Sleepers [/h1]
Looting sleepers will now correctly take the items from the sleeper. We had an issue with players looting sleepers and the sleeper player loading back in to find his weapons perfectly intact.

[h1]Server Password for Server Admin Rank [/h1]
Locate the "server config.txt" file and edit the "serverPassword" when you are hosting a Nomad server. The server files are located at your install directory on Steam. 

After changing your password, simply log in to your server by doing /password <password> and then you will be granted with "Server Admin". With Server Admin, you can use /give /tp /speed commands. More to come!

[h1]Complete Changelog [/h1]
I added a whole lot more to Nomad in this update. Read below for the full list of changes. All these changes were made on my Twitch. channel at twitch.tv/bluemurdergaming - come in one time and say hi!

- /players is now fixed
- storm is now more accurate when hip firing
- storm is now less accurate when aiming
- storm damage has been reduced to 20, down from 25
- new weapon, KA-74 has been added
- new weapon ammo type, 7.62MM has been added (for KA-74)
- updated 5.56mm ammo box icon
- deers will now run away from you get close
- deers run speed has been increased
- deers angular speed increased
- server password has been added to the "server config.txt" (CHANGE THIS WHEN HOSTING!) use /password <password> then you can use all /tp /give commands
- stealing items from sleepers will now correctly take the items from the sleeper
- fixed animation bug when punching then instantly changing to another weapon
- zombies will now cull at 250 units away, up from 200
- zombies now sync up better
- deers now sync up better
- zombie idle animations at start up will now correctly display
- ammo box will now open 7.62mm ammo
- changed police and military loot tables
- presents will now include the new KA-47 and 7.62MM ammo
- medical pack now cures broken legs
- zombie brute armour now properly culls
- cooked venison now heals you for 25hp, up from 10hp
- cooked venison now gives +45 food, up from +40
- raw zombie meat has been added to the game and drop from zombies
- cooked zombie meat has been added
- eating and drinking sound effects have been added
- footstep volume reduced
- fixed issue when logging out and hearing a cluster**** of sounds

notes.title: 0.4 Patch Notes (Winter Update)
notes.content:
It's a little early for the winter update, but here it is.

[h1]New UI[/h1]
Brand new server, player and chat UI.

[h1]New Zombie[/h1]
A new type of zombie has been added, "Stalker". Which runs really fast but has low HP

[h1]Chat Commands[/h1]
The new chat system comes with commands. All commands are now "/<command>" and not "!<command>" - do /help for all available commands.

[h1] New Servers[/h1]
We are no longer a partner of Shrug Hosting (see last update) so everything has been moved to new servers (which I am hosting).

[h1]Server Config Files[/h1]
You can now edit core settings within Nomad on your server. See "server config.txt" for all settings. 

All settings must have a space after the ":" - see the default config for example.

Please note, using high numbers for AI spawns may break clients or the server, so keep everything within reason.

We have also updated the launch params and moved the LAUNCH SERVER.bat to START.bat - please move your server to the new server.exe and start.bat

[h1]Winter Stuff[/h1]
Whole new christmas and winter stuff has been added. The whole world is now winter themed. 

Players will spawn with a random winter costume and is giving a present. Open the present to recieve rewards (that spawn around you).

[h1]Deers[/h1] 
Deers are back and can be hunted for meat. Zombies also chase and attack them.

[h1]Complete Changelog[/h1] 
Here is the changelog for 0.4:

- new server main UI
- added mute button to server UI
- new player UI (health/hunger/thirst/ammo display)
- new chat UI (it now saves previous messages and now scrolls!)
- fixed campfire buff icon when you are in multiple campfire areas (no more spam!)
- all commands are now /<command> not !<command>
- new /help command
- you can now view all players by typing /players into chat
- the world is now snowy
- servers will now display ping
- updated launch parameters for the Nomad Server located in your steam folder/Nomad (-port) and includes a new lobby server IP
- shrug hosting servers are no longer available (the host is no longer a nomad partner as they are not replying to any messages or  providing services)
- ladders can no longer be used in unauthorized building areas (workbench areas)
- deers are now in the game and can be hunted
- zombies can attack deers and kill them 
- zombies are now slightly faster
- new zombie, "Stalker" - runs really fast but has low HP
- removed motion blur when turning fast (spikes FPS)
- all zombies are now christmas themed
- new winter hats: santas beard, santas hat, santas hat and beard (in 1)
- new winter clothes: santa costume (torso and legs) and christmas elf costume (torso and legs)
- presents are now in the game
- raw and cooked venison added (cook at a campfire)
- you can now craft a sleeping bag out of 4 bandages
- sleeping bag health has been reduced to 20, from 50
- metal can now spawn at industrial areas
- smoke trails have been added to supply crates
- you can now edit server config files

notes.title: 0.36 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Another big update to Nomad, this one features new zombie AI and more.

[h1]Zombies[/h1]
Zombies now have pathfinding which means they will no longer walk into walls and get stuck.

Zombies now are faster and stronger than before

A new type of zombie has been added. A stronger version of a zombie with armour and increased health.

[h1]Buildings[/h1]
Some stairs on the buildings have been fixed and you no longer get stuck walking up stairs

[h1]Supply Drops[/h1]
Supply drops are now in the game. There are 2 different types of supply drops, a medical and a military one. 

Medical supply crates drop all medical items randomly inside. Military supply crates drop all weapons and armor randomly inside.

[h1]XP System[/h1]
XP system added. Each player and zombie kill will grant the player XP. XP doesn't do anything right now but later down the line we are planning on costumes that you can buy (with XP) in game.

You lose 50% of your XP on death.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
Here is the complete changelog for 0.36

- fixed stairs on red houses
- fixed stairs on super market
- added more weapons & ammo to military and police loot table 
- added more weapons & ammo to houses, apartments, cars and caravan spawns
- fixed white texture issue on pine tree model
- houses will now spawn more loot
- fixed well impact collider
- small terrain changes
- added extra tent areas to new terrain piece
- street lights culling has been decreased
- zombies now have pathfinding
- zombie run and idle animation has been changed
- zombie aggro range has been increased from 50, to 75
- police outfit added (including a hat!)
- new police station loot table
- bigger and stronger zombie added
- zombies will no longer seem like they have disappeared after you die (viewing from the death cam)
- increased zombies culling out from 130 units away to 150 units away
- new zombie spawner added - this will ensure that there will always be zombies spawned in the map
- zombies will now spawn randomly around all locations and not a set amount per location
- zombie damage decreased from 8,20 to 4,10
- players will now start with a torch
- new zombie sound effects
- XP system added - this is a global xp system, used for unlocking costumes at a later stage
- added motion blur when turning fast
- added supply crates (randomly spawn in the world)
- fixed collider issue with tusten sign
- fixed bug where total number of items in storage containers wouldn't show correctly
- added more wrecked vehicles and tents around the map
- added pumpkin hat for halloween (everyone starts with it!)

notes.title: 0.35 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1] Terrain Changes [/h1]
Version 0.35 has a lot of terrain changes. We've included more wrecked vehicles, street lights, texture changes/fixes, new hills and a whole new section of the map.

The new section of the map is located on the same island as Pinewood. The new section features a new super market, a town, military area and a industrial area.

[h1] Weapon Fixes/Balances/Changes [/h1]
We've tightened up most of the weapons so that they are more accurate when aiming down sights. The heckler, storm and hunting bow are now way more accurate when shooting and aiming.

The heckler gun model has been changed aswell.

[h1] Sky and Weather Changes[/h1]
We've changed the renderer mode from deffered to forward rendering and included a whole new sky system complete with new clouds. We have also included fog that surrounds the distance.

As we have changed rendering mode, we have also included AA.

[h1] Zombie Changes[/h1]
Zombies now hit 100% harder and there are now 100% more of them around the map. As the zombies are still in early development, please let us know if you find any bugs with the newly increased number of zombies.


[h1] New Crafting Items[/h1]
You can now craft a rabbit trap to trap rabbits for meat. Once you have the raw rabbit meat, you can cook it over a campfire. To do this simply go to the crafting tab (TAB > Crafting) and look under the new drop down menu "Food". 

[h1] Player Spawning[/h1]
Every player will now spawn at a random beach, unless you already have a sleeper somewhere, or a sleeping bag.

[h1] Servers Have Been Wiped [/h1]
As we have done a lot of terrain work, we needed to wipe the servers as some of the changes may result in a hill, or a tree being in your base. Or because we have removed a few hills, it may result in your base (and your sleeper) hovering way above the ground.

So we had to wipe everything.

This means all your player information, player and world loot and player bases have all been wiped. 

[h1] VOIP [/h1]
You can now talk to each other inside of Nomad using your microphone. Press V to talk. As this is a early and first pass feature of VOIP, you may find bugs.

[h1] Changelog [/h1]
There are many, many other changes that came with version 0.35. Here is the full changelog:

- peaches mcgee will now correctly show in hands whilst drinking
- removed old prototype petrol station model
- terrain and map changes
- new section of the map with new town and other buildings (extended main island)
- new prompts when trying to upgrade a structure but it is damaged (needs to be fully repaired first)
- new UI prompt when entering building mode
- changes to how furnaces and campfire audio will play
- storm is now twice as accurate when aiming down sights (from 0.3 to 0.15)
- heckler hip aiming bullet spread decreased from 2.5 to 2.0
- heckler aiming down sights bullet spread decreased from 1 to 0.2
- hunting bow hip aiming spread decreased from 2 to 1.25
- hunting bow aimed spread decreased from 1 to 0.15
- hunting bow arrow fall off limit increased to 30, up from 10
- thor bullet now has trail effects
- all weapon's bullet speed have been doubled 
- new sky and cloud system
- lakeview, tusten and more locations named
- optimizations to the damage script with large number of player buildings
- decreased network call timer on all object timers to help with network lag on large number of loot
- zombie spawns increased by 100%
- optimized wrecked car gameobject
- fixed errors with building areas that appeared last update
- damage to sleeping players has been increased by 300%
- zombie's damage has been increased from 4-10 to 6-20
- lights will now cull at a distance of 400 units/meters
- small optimization to the furnace script
- renderering mode changed to forward, from deffered
- AA added 
- fog has now been added
- removed unity splash screen at start up
- increased fixed timestamp to 0.033 (30fps), from 0.04 (25fps)
- slowed down the walking bob animation
- drastically improved performance on storage chests and sleepers
- other FPS improvements
- increased raycasting distance on bullets to help with collision
- removed sun flares
- menu changes
- wrecked vehicles now spawn items around them and have their own loot table
- player spawn points moved to all beaches (you can only spawn on beaches)
- axe and pickaxe model on third person is now bigger
- fixed FPS issue when aiming with weapons
- changed the heckler weapon model
- doubled the damage on bleeding to 1, from 0.5
- rabbit trap added to the game under Crafting > Traps & Barricades
- rabbit meat & cooked rabbit meat added
- voip added (v to talk)
- reduced background sound effects volume by half
- reduced footstep volume
- reduced bullet impact volume

notes.title: 0.33 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We've been busy making the new patch for Nomad. Here is what is included in version 0.33.

[b]Wells[/b]
Wells have been added to the game. It was long overdue but you can now finally refill your empty canteens. Wells are scattered throughout the map, at places like the military area, pinewood and other places. Can you find them?

[b]Character skins[/b]
A total of 12 character skins have been added. This was a highly requested feature as everyone in Nomad looked the same. However, you do not get to choose your appearance or gender (yup, we added female skins!), instead it will be randomly assigned to you at a new life spawn. Just like in real life, you do not choose your gender or appearance.

Waking up at your sleeper will still keep your appearance and gender. You will only be assigned a new skin if you've been killed or spawning into the server for the first time.

[b]Bullets and C4[/b]
Bullet speed has been increased on all weapons and major changes to the C4 has been done. The C4 will now explode and damage structures and damagable items within a radius around the C4. 

[b]Complete Changelog[/b]
0.33
- slight changes to zombie walk animation
- you can now fill canteens at wells that are scattered throughout the map
- canteen (empty) tooltip changed
- you can no longer change weapon using the scroll wheel when aiming down a weapon.
- thor now has adjustable zoom (scroll wheel)
- all bullets have increased bullet speed 
- heckler bullet speed has been significally increased
- c4 now affects all structures and destructables in a radius
- new food item: tatty's crunch chili favoured crisps
- eating rabbit food will now display the correct item in hands
- 12 new characters skins have been added, including female skins and they will be assigned randomly at new life spawn (not waking up at sleeper)
- changes to the zombie culling
- increased width of block 19 in hands (third person)
- fixed issue with muzzleflash staying on after you shot
- eating peaches mcgee will now correctly display the model in hands

notes.title: 0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]NEW UI [/b]
All the major UI screens and menus have been updated. You can swap out clothing items and bags instantly within the new menu. No more unequipping and equipping items, hooray! 

Right click an item in the inventory to drop, left click to use the item and use middle mouse button to shred chest and leg clothing items.

[b]ZOMBIES [/b]
We've done some changes to the zombies that will need to be heavily tested. Please be aware that you may encounter some funky bugs whilst battling them.

We've also increased the spawns.

[b]WHAT'S NEXT? [/b]
We will now be focusing on adding extra clothing items, weapons, food and drink etc to the game. More of everything, basically. We will also be working through all of your suggestions and adding them into the game - not the stupid ones or the OP ones.


[b]CHANGELOG[/b]
Here is the complete changelog for 0.3:

- inputing the wrong key on doors will now close the key window
- fixed highlighting issue on the inventory windows
- trees have new textures
- new inventory menu
- new crafting menu
- new storage chest UI
- new sleeper UI
- new furnace UI
- replaced player UI
- moved buff/debuff icons and ammo placement box
- you can now instantly switch between clothing items without unequiping them first
- you can now switch bags instantly (overflowing items will drop on the floor)
- weapon slots from main UI has been removed (see new inventory for slots)
- to shred tshirts or jeans use the middle mouse scroll button
- fixed issue with looting wood(clone), metal ore(clone) and stone(clone) items
- increased military tower culling
- fixed an error with remote gun audio sounds
- removed cooldown when crafting items
- removed cooldown when equiping certain items
- fixed metal barricades not returning the correct inventory space
- large bag size increased to 18, up from 14 (24 in total)
- medium bag size increased to 12, up from 8 (18 in total)
- fixed GUI errors when loading the map for the first time
- small GUI optimizations
- you can now change weapons with mouse scroll
- small storage chest size increased to 12, up from 5
- large storage chest size increased to 30, up from 20
- fixed notification "use storage chest" when chest is already being used
- fixed notification "use" when sleeper is already being used
- fixed notification "use furnace" when furnace is already being used
- fixed issue with using chests, sleepers and furnaces too fast when you load
- you now need a pickaxe to mine
- you now need an axe to gather wood from trees
- increased solver iteration count
- zombies no longer share a network call for movement
- fixed zombie animation bug
- increased spawning of zombies
- increased zombie aggro range by 66%
- furnace size decreased to 12, from 30
- furnaces no longer require wood to burn
- metal ore smelting time increased to 300 seconds, up from 200 seconds
- increased pick axe spawns
- increased fire axe spawns at fire station
- you can now craft a pickaxe and a fire axe from the crafting menu (requires metal & wood)
- you can no longer build structures on the bridge

notes.title: 0.214 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- the servers have all been wiped due to the duplication bug. this means your character, items and bases have been deleted. if you are hosting a server yourself, we suggest you wipe the server.dat file before installing the new patch
- chests and furnaces will no longer duplicate items when destroyed
- small optimizations to the map
- chat fixes
- fixed a bug where sometimes birds didn't spawn
- wooden door placement material fixed
- increased stone structures health to 50k, up from 9k
- increased metal door health to 50k, up from 10k 
- increased workbench area from 60x60x60 to 100x100x100
- sprinting time is no longer based on food and drink levels, instead it's unlimited but ticks down your food and drink by x2
- changes to the building system to help increase performance
- building a door must now require a doorway first
- you can now jump with broken legs
- you can now build a third and forth floor to your base (floors will increase throughout the alpha to test stability)
- a few optimizations to the items that spawn in the world
- optimizations to the chest, sleepers and door scripts to help increase performance
- fixed a bug where it didn't display spaces in your name correctly
- increased repair value for metal doors and all stone structures by 10x
- c4 has been added and can be crafted under Weapons (1 explosives + 3 metal)
- explosives have been added (use to craft C4 and other bombs later)
- main menu music fix
- fixed some placeable objects not finding correct position or spawning correctly
- small optimizations to the player
- wooden structures have been retextured for added detail
- stone structures have been retextured for added detail
- fixed stone low wall texture
- you can no longer create bases around important buildings and areas
- dead characters now have a new texture
- added subtle sound effect when a chat message is recieved

notes.title: Nomad Roadmap for the future
notes.content:
Hey guys, 

First up I would like to address some concerns people are having with the game being a reskinned "UnitZ". I assure you that I am not using UnitZ Asset Pack from the Unity Store and that I developed Nomad before that asset pack was released (Nomad development started in November). I streamed the entire development process over on my Twitch channel (www.twitch.tv/bluemurdergaming) and wrote a dev blog over at www.playnomad.net. 

Now that's over, let's get into what's in store for the game. I want to keep you guys close in the loop throughout the entire development process and be 100% honest with the game. I will be taking community feedback for every new feature and changes to better the player experience. If you don't like a change, let me know about it so we can work closely on changing it. 

[b]New Inventory Screen[/b]
First up is the inventory screen. This is still pretty much a prototype and I hope to change this with a better one. I wanted to do something different than the traditional grid format with icons, but it turns out that we will probably go to this style. All chests and furnaces screens will share this new layout.

[b]New Equip Screen[/b]
I'm hoping to change the Equip Screen to more of a traditional MMORPG screen. For example, you will see icons around the character for different slots (chest slots, leg slot etc). I think that is easier to read than the list view we currently have now.

[b]Crafting Menu[/b]
The crafting menu was a prototype. My aim is to fully re-do this screen with better graphics and visuals. Right now it's a little fiddley and clunky.

[b]Zombies[/b]
Zombies are boring, I want something different - even if it's just a reskin into another mob. Perhaps Robots? Mechs? Aliens? I'm also up to idea of having no mobs in the game. I don't know exactly what I want to do here. I will be taking feedback and comments from you guys on this. 

[b]Hunting[/b]
Bring back hunting. There is already deer in the game, however it's currently disabled due to poor performance. I hope to bring this back as soon as possible and include more variants of deer, as well as new animals.

[b]New Map[/b]
Make the map bigger! Not only that but completely re-do the whole terrain and add proper mountains, cliffs, rivers and forests. New tree models will also be added.

[b]New Items[/b]
New clothing items, weapons, medical items and more will be added to the game. Got a suggestion for an item? Let me know here or on the live stream and if I like it, I'll add it!

[b]Base Building[/b]
Upgrade the visuals of the base building pieces and add more pieces to play with. More variants of different pieces, for example having two windows instead of one.

[b]Character Model[/b]
The biggest issue I currently have with Nomad is the character model. It's essentially just a cube and 5 other cuboids and it was animated within unity. There are no bones attached to the model, so it hinders animation quality. My biggest aim is to replace this model with a brand new one and fully rig it. This will allow us to properly animate the model.

All these changes will be added to a new branch so you can test it before it moves over to the stable default branch. More information on this will come when we get there.
